vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.source: auto(8.0): It is the age of faster than light travel and advanced cyber-robotics.
vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.r27_localized: auto(8.0): 这是超光速航行与先进赛博机器人技术的时代。

vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.source: auto(8.0): [THE 3P ORGANIZATION] has become a driving force for space exploration.
vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.r27_localized: auto(8.0): [3P组织]已成为推动太空探索的一股重要力量。

vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.source: auto(8.0): Brave heroes are sent out by [THE 3P ORGANIZATION] to gather information.
vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.r27_localized: auto(8.0): [3P组织]派出英勇之士，前往各地收集情报。

vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.source: auto(8.0): These [COSMOBREEDERS], as they are known, allow civilization to prosper.
vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.r27_localized: auto(8.0): 这些被称为[宇宙育种者]的英雄，让文明得以繁荣。

vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.source: auto(8.0): Traveling through the stars and making new discoveries is a life of adventure.
vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.r27_localized: auto(8.0): 穿行群星，探寻未知，这就是冒险的人生。

vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.source: auto(8.0): Respected by all, many a child dreams of growing up to become a [COSMOBREEDER]
vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.r27_localized: auto(8.0): 人人敬仰，许多孩子梦想长大后成为[宇宙育种者]。

vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.source: auto(8.0): Space travel and leaving the safety of home is not for the faint of heart, however.
vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.r27_localized: auto(8.0): 然而，离开安稳的家园、踏上星际旅途，绝非胆小者所能为。

vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.source: auto(8.0): For who can truly say what dangers await on distant, unknown planets...
vsn/ClassicPreTitle/script.vsn.r27_localized: auto(8.0): 毕竟，谁又能说清遥远的未知星球上潜藏着什么危险……

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: Hey, you don't have to hurt him anymore! See, I've got him. He's being good!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 喂，不用再打他了！看，我控制住他了。他很乖！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: I've actually been studying this species in depth. I'm basically an expert now!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我可是深入研究过这个物种的，基本算专家啦！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: They might look a lil scary, but they're really just misunderstood, ya know?
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们看着有点吓人，其实只是被误解了，懂吗？

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: And to think that I ran away  the first time I met a pack of barkers!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 想想当初，第一次遇到一群吠犬，我竟然掉头就跑！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: Admittedly, they kinda ambushed and scattered my squad!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 得承认，他们确实伏击并冲散了我的小队！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: To a layperson, that might seem a little hostile. Now I know that we should have all
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 外行或许觉得这有点敌意。现在我才懂，我们都该

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: just lifted our tails and let them breed us straight away!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 直接抬起尾巴，任他们操进来配种！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentB02F03
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentB02F03

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: Naturally, I had no hope of outrunning these swift and powerful hunters!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 当然，我根本跑不过这些敏捷强壮的猎手！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: After a brief chase, they knocked me to the ground for even daring to try.
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 追了没多久，他们就把我扑倒，惩罚我竟敢逃跑。

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: As they tore the suit from my body, I was too weak to fight them...
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们撕扯我身上的制服时，我虚弱得无力反抗……

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: It was pretty scary! I thought they were gonna eat me right there!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 真吓人！我以为他们当场就要吃了我！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentB02F04
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentB02F04

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: But I quickly realized that they were more curious than hungry...
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 但我很快就发现，他们与其说是饿，不如说是好奇……

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: ...and one particular place was getting an awful lot of attention!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……尤其是某个部位，格外受他们关注！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: So - nervously at first! - I spread out to let them get a closer look.
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 于是——起初还挺紧张！——我张开双腿，让他们看个仔细。

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentB02F05
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentB02F05

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: As an eager but gentle tongue lapped at my sex, I was confronted
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 热切又温柔的舌头舔着我的小穴时，我眼前出现了

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: with a surprisingly familiar part of barker anatomy...
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 眼前却凑来吠犬身上一个熟悉得出奇的部位……

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: My heart was racing, but training kicked in and I began to nurse that shaft.
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我心跳如鼓，可训练的本能发作，便开始吮吸那根肉棒。

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: When I closed my eyes, it was kinda like a little taste of home, hehe...
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 一闭上眼，还真有点家的味道，嘿嘿……

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentB02F06
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentB02F06

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: I must have done a pretty good job too, because soon enough the rest of the
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我一定伺候得很不错，因为没多久，其他的

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: pack was lining up for my mouth. I may have slept through exolinguistics class
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 其他同伴都排起队等我的嘴。我上外星语言学课也许在睡觉

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: but a little 'exolingus' is all I needed to communicate with these boys!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可只需一点‘外星舔语’，就能跟这些男生沟通啦！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentB02F07
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentB02F07

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: After that first encounter, I happily joined their pack. For a while, I even tried
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 初次交欢后，我开开心心地入了群。有阵子，我甚至试着

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: walking around on all fours, barking and growling. They seemed to like that!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 四脚着地，到处爬，汪汪叫、低声吼。他们还挺喜欢！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: But most of all, they liked it when I raised my tail for them...
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过，他们最喜欢的还是我翘起尾巴……

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: Oh yes, I did some  v e r y  thorough field work. All the data you could want!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没错，我的实地调查可真够深入。要什么数据都有！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentB02F08
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentB02F08

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: My packmates were demanding lovers, but never took me harder than I could handle.
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 族里的伴侣虽索求无度，却从不会操得让我受不了。

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: Sucking 'em may have reminded me a lil of home...
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 给他们口交时，倒让我有点想起家里……

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: ...but there was nothing homestyle about how they mounted me!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……可他们骑上来操我的方式，跟家里完全不同！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: Good luck finding a two leg- ged guy who makes you gasp with every! single! thrust!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 想找个两条腿的家伙，每！一！下！都能顶得你倒抽气？做梦吧！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentB02F09
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentB02F09

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: Eventually, one of the bigger males decided that I was proper mate material.
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 终于，有个大块头雄性觉得我很适合当配偶。

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: Not much of a talker, but he knew how to treat a girl, if ya know what I mean!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他话不多，却懂得怎么疼姑娘，你懂的！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: He protected me, hunted for me, and mounted me  h a r d  every night!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他保护我、为我狩猎，每晚都狠狠地干我！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentB02F10
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentB02F10

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: He was the first to actually tie me, and jeez that... that was...huff...
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他是第一个真跟我锁结的，天哪，那……那简直……呼……

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: A! M! A! Z! I! N! G!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 爽！翻！天！了！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: I was walking funny for like two days, but I didn't care!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我走路别扭了两天，可我才不在乎！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: He took me away and we kinda settled down together in this little den.
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他把我带走，我们就在这小窝里一起安顿下来了。

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: I think he was tryin' to gimme his puppies. It was pretty cute <3
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我看，他是想让我怀上他的小狗崽。挺可爱的 <3

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): Black
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): Black

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: So the next time you see a barker, don't go smacking him around!
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以下次见到吠犬，可别上去就揍他！

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: text: Holster that tazer and back away slowly. Or just lift your tail, hehe...
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 收起电击枪，慢慢后退。或者干脆翘起尾巴，嘿嘿……

vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.source: wait: 0.2
vsn/f_AgentF01/script.vsn.r27_localized: wait: 0.2

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: Owwie... Thanks for dealing with that nasty robo fella.
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哎哟……多谢你收拾了那讨厌的机器人。

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: Hard to imagine that this... uhh... still wiggling... appendage thing...
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 真难想象这条……呃……还在蠕动的……附肢……

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: ...was able to force me to the big-O over and over...!
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……竟能逼得我一遍遍高潮……！

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: Usually I'm pretty good at evading capture, but I got sloppy down here on Tutone.
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 平时我很擅长躲避抓捕，但在图托恩大意了。

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: First I got bumped into by some space pirates. No biggy, right?
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 起先撞见几个太空海盗。没什么大不了，对吧？

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: Could've easily taken them out, even if I was scouting around nude and all.
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 就算我光着身子侦察，也能轻松收拾他们。

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: ...'cept I couldn't help but notice it wasn't a /fight/ these boys were after!
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……不过我还是看出来了，这帮男人想要的可不是/打架/！

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: I settled down a liiiiittle, just enough to let them think they won the tussle
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我稍——微安分了一点，刚好让他们以为自己打赢了

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: and wouldn't you know it? Wham! One of them grabbed my arms and just /went/ for it!
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你猜怎么着？砰！一个家伙抓住我双臂，直接/开干/了！

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: No lie, it'd been a hot minute since I got myself laid.
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不骗你，我还真有段日子没做爱了。

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: Before even coming on down to this planet, right? So I was all for a lil gangbang.
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 甚至在下到这颗星球之前，对吧？所以我很乐意来场小群交。

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: After they saw that I wasn't gonna run, the boys just let me handle them as I pleased
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 看我不打算逃，那帮家伙就任我随意摆弄了，

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: they'd just shove their dick in my direction and I'd sort out what to do with 'em!
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们只管把鸡巴往我这边一递，怎么伺候就由我来定！

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: The group of them weren't picky, and neither was I!
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们这群家伙都不挑，我也一样！

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: I stuck around for a few nights, really working through my pent up energy.
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我留下过了几夜，彻底发泄了积压的精力。

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: Reminded me of my academy days, almost!
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 简直让我想起了在学院的日子！

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: As many boys to fill you as you wanted, food and drink coming in from... somewhere?
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 想要多少男人填满你就有多少，吃喝也不知从哪儿送来？

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: You ever try that sour milk stuff the pirates make?
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你尝过海盗酿的那种酸奶吗？

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: Stuff is wild, it'll make you feel like you're made of jelly if you drink enough!
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那玩意可猛了，喝多了，整个人都软得像果冻！

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: Oh yeah! Eventually I bid farewell to the party animals.
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哦，对！最后我跟那群狂欢的野兽告别了。

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: I did have a mission to complete, right?
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我毕竟还有任务要完成，对吧？

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: Fortunately the space pirates seemed to have another plaything ready
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 幸好那帮太空海盗似乎已经备好了另一个玩物，

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: so they didn't give me much guff. Just a quick blowy and handy and off I went.
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以他们也没怎么为难我，吹一吹、撸一撸，我就走了。

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: And wouldn't you know it! Shortly after leaving I bumped into more Tutoners!
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你猜怎么着！离开没多久，我又撞见了图托恩人！

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: Short with big ears... This must've been one of those Fenfen fellas!
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 个子小，耳朵大……这肯定就是Fenfen的家伙了！

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: Heard about them from the local barkeep around these parts.
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我听这附近的酒保说起过他们。

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: Was told that I should maybe give them a hand if I could, and now here one was!
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 有人说力所能及就帮帮他们，这不，眼前就有一个！

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: This little fella just had cold robotic eyes, and they weren't no friend.
vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这小家伙只有冰冷的机械眼，绝不是什么朋友。

vsn/f_AgentF02/script.vsn.source: text: By the time I parsed what I was really looking at, it was too late for me...

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 当时我和狐姑娘黛蕾尔一起侦察！咱俩一队！

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: She's been on, like, a ton of missions, right? And she just got off of desk duty
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 她出过超多次任务，对吧？而且才刚结束文职工作，

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: so we got paired up to find some of the, like, missing agents right?
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以我们就搭档来找那些失踪特工啦，对吧？

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: I don't have much combat experience so Daleir like, totally gave me some hints
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我没什么战斗经验，黛蕾尔就给了我不少指点，

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: like how you can go without a uniform or equipment when scouting! For extra stealth!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 比如侦察时可以不穿制服、不带装备！更加隐蔽！

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC01F03
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC01F03

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: It worked out real good for the first couple of scouting runs, but then...
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 头几次侦察顺利得很，谁知道后来……

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: ...one of the creepy jungle monster things caught me!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……一只吓人的丛林怪物抓住我了！

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: I didn't see them in the pre- mission briefings so I was like, totally lost
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 任务简报里没见过它们，我当时完全懵了，

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: but thankfully Daleir had a real clear head and told me to kick away at them!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 幸好黛蕾尔很清醒，叫我使劲踢开他们！

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC01F04
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC01F04

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: S-she said I was doing, like, a real great job...
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 她、她说我干得，嗯，特别好……

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: But it kinda seemed like it was just turning on the creepo monster? Like WTF?
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可那好像只让变态怪物更兴奋了？这他妈什么鬼？

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: I dunno, sometime during my wrestling with that beast Daleir like, disappeared?
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我也不懂，跟那野兽扭打时，黛蕾尔不知怎么就不见了？

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: I was crawling around trying to look for her but...
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我到处爬着想找她，可是……

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC01F05
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC01F05

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: ...that monster lifted me up and decided I was like, a fuckbuddy now???
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……那怪物把我抱起来，就直接把我当炮友了？？？

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: I have nooo clue what got him so rowdy but I continued to try fight back
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 完全搞不懂他怎么这么疯，不过我还是继续反抗

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: just like Daleir had told me to...
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 就像黛蕾尔叮嘱我的那样……

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: ...but it was SERIOUSLY starting to seem like a, like, bad idea!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……可我真的越来越觉得，这主意糟透了！

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC01F06
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC01F06

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: Even when I tried to crawl away the slimy punk couldn't, like, take a hint.
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我都想爬走了，那黏糊糊的混蛋还不懂我的意思。

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: Gotta admit that his tongue was, like, pretty good...
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过得承认，他的舌头，怎么说呢，还挺厉害……

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: Real slimy, but in a /fun/ way, you know? Like, not a gross sort of way that...
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 滑溜溜的，但滑得/有趣/，懂吧？不是恶心的那种……

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: ...no wait, no getting distracted!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……不对，等等，不能分心！

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC01F07
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC01F07

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: Yeah I finally got tired of the guy after, like, not seeing Daleir around
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 是啊，一直没见黛蕾尔回来，我终于腻了那家伙，

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: figured it was time to take things into my own paws!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 心想是时候亲爪处理这件事了！

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: ...so I took a branch into my own paws!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……所以我就亲爪抄起一根树枝！

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: ...and then I, like, applied the branch to the creepo guy's head!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……然后嘛，我就把树枝招呼到那恶心家伙脑袋上！

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC01F08
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC01F08

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: A good smack got them like, totally dazed. And off I, like, went!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 狠狠一敲，就把他们敲晕乎了。然后我就溜啦！

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: They're like, creepy and crawly and got a vicious tail, but those monsters
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那些怪物爬来爬去怪吓人的，尾巴还很凶，不过它们

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: aren't real good at following a girl at alllllll.
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 追起姑娘来可就差——远了。

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: Lost them pretty easily by dipping into this old unused cell!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 往这间废旧牢房一钻，就轻松甩掉他们啦！

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC01F09
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC01F09

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: Aaaaand then I found out why it was old and unused when these, like, tentacles
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 然后——我才搞懂这间旧牢房为何一直空置，那些触手竟然

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: just started wrapping around and caressing me!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 就开始缠住我，抚摸起来！

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: I swear, ohmygawsh, that these things were actually horny! Like, for real!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 天呐，我发誓，那些东西真会发情！真的！

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC01F10
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC01F10

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: I've just been stuck here for like, hours? Days? I can't really remember...
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我困在这里多久了，几小时？几天？真记不清了……

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: ...it's just been like, orgasm after orgasm...
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……就那么，高潮接着高潮……

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: Almost like being surrounded by a wall of those monsters' tongues, you know?
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 简直像被那些怪物的舌头围成的墙裹住了，懂吗？

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: Like, it sounds gross, but it also felt really good and then...
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 就是，听着挺恶心，可感觉真的很舒服，然后……

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): Black
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): Black

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: ...hey wait, didn't I have a mission I was supposed to be doing?
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……哎等等，我是不是还有任务要做来着？

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: What was it that, like, I was supposed to even be helping out with...
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我本来到底是要帮忙干什么来着……

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: Daleir just said that she was gonna get us taken care of, but then this happened
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 黛蕾尔说她会把咱们安顿好，结果就出了这事，

vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.source: text: so I guess I'll leave the rest of the job up to you and her!
vsn/f_AgentF05/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以剩下的工作就交给你和她啦！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: music: CutsceneX
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: music: CutsceneX

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: snap: AgentC02F01
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: snap: AgentC02F01

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: Awww, you didn't have to beat up those lil ol' tentacles!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哎呀，你不用揍那些小触手的！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: They weren't hurting me, just helping to keep me warm and cozy, eh-heh!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 它们没伤我，只是让我暖暖和和、舒舒服服的，嘿嘿！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: I guuuuess I oughtta give you the report while I'm out, huh? So here ya go:
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我想——既然脱身了，总该把报告交给你吧？喏，拿好：

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06):AgentC01F02
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06):AgentC01F02

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: Not sure where she is now, but I actually started out down here with a partner!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不知她现在在哪，但我刚来这下面时，其实有个搭档！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: Erma the otter and me, Daleir the fox! What a team we were!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 水獭厄玛，还有我，狐狸黛蕾尔！多棒的搭档啊！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: I've been on lotsa missions and fights but Erma never saw much combat...
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我出过不少任务，打过不少仗，可厄玛没怎么实战过……

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: ...so I was around to give her some pointers in case we ran into anyone!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……所以我陪着她，遇上谁也好指点她几招！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06):Black
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06):Black

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: I can't remember whaaaat exactly happened, but we got separated at some point...
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 具体发——生了什么我记不清了，反正我们后来走散了……

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: ...yeah, that's it... I started looking around for her...
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……对，就是这样……我开始到处找她……

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: Eventually I heard her cry out, so I tried to quietly make my way to her!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 后来听见她叫，我就试着悄悄摸过去！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC02F02
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC02F02

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: And, well, wouldn't you know it! I didn't have to give Erma any pointers at all!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 结果你猜怎么着！我压根不用指点厄玛！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: The girl was a natural at Cosmobreeding!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那姑娘做宇宙育种简直是天生的！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: She knew how to kick and struggle juuust right to arouse the local fauna
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 她踢腿挣扎的劲儿恰到好处，正好能挑起当地生物的欲火，

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: even though this species wasn't even in any of our pre-sortie briefings! Wow!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可出发前的简报里压根没提过这物种！哇！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC02F03
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC02F03

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: Seeing the way she egged on this alien creature with her rough foreplay...
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 看她用粗暴的前戏挑逗那外星生物的样子……

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: ...and seeing how hard that creature was getting... eh-hehehe...
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……再看看那异星生物硬成什么样……诶嘿嘿嘿……

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: ...I knew I had to find myself one of them boys!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……我就知道，得找一个那样的汉子！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC02F04
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC02F04

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: After trudging around loudly, I finally found a lone creepy crawly buddy
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我踩着响步走了好久，终于找到一个落单的虫虫伙伴，

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: so I made myself known to him, nice and slowly-like.
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 于是我慢慢悠悠、和和气气地让他发现了我。

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: It's important not to look too aggressive, when you're trying to get cosmobred!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 想让人给自己育种，可千万别显得太凶！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: Definitely didn't want him to think I was challenging him to a fight!!! At all!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我绝不想让他以为我在挑衅！！！一点也不想！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC02F05
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC02F05

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: Despite my attempts to be nice and friendly I could tell that my would-be friend
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 尽管我努力友好相待，可我看得出这位准朋友，

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: was not about to let me get off easily... Eh-heh...
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可没打算让我这么容易就爽到……诶嘿……

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: I was gonna have to work to get off this time! I mean, get away this time!!!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这回想爽到可得卖力了！我是说，想脱身！！！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC02F06
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC02F06

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: One blood-curdling scream from the alien later and I found myself on my back!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那外星生物一声骇人的尖叫，我就被掀翻在地！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: Wow could these boys move fast, I'd hate to come across one in the dark.
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哇，这帮家伙动作真快，我可不想在暗处碰上其中一只。

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: He'd be on top of you and pounding away before you even saw him...
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你还没看见他，他就已经压着你猛干了……

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: -Anyway! He was real grabby, and I had to do all I could to try to beat him off!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ——总之！他手脚很不老实，我只好使尽浑身解数把他撸退！

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AgentC02F07
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AgentC02F07

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.source: text: After a few minutes of clawing and kicking, I turned and hiked my tail-
vsn/f_AgentF06/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 又抓又踢了几分钟后，我转身翘起尾巴——

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 赶紧汇报完吧，我还得去找那些把我丢在这儿的混蛋算账。

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaA02B
rewind!
text: There was a whole group of Kobos. Spotted them while I was scouting out the area
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我侦察那一带时，发现了一整群科博德。

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: Seemed like they had no discipline, just sitting around gaggling and giggling
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们毫无纪律，就坐在那儿叽叽喳喳、嬉笑打闹

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: not even keeping a lookout for any sort of rapacious agents that might come by!
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 连可能路过的贪婪特工都不提防！

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: Made my vulpine blood boil to see such lackaisical pirates...
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 海盗这么懒散，看得我这狐狸都火冒三丈……

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaA02C
rewind!
text: ...so down I want, tazer first, to show these slobs how things should go!
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……我举着电击枪下去，教这群蠢货该怎么办！

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: Didn't take much to make the cowards submit. As soon as I took out the first one
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 让这帮胆小鬼屈服很容易。我刚放倒头一个

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: the remaining pirates just threw their hands up in the air.
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 剩下的海盗就全举手投降了。

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: ...It was even worse than I thought!
cut(0.06): AreaA02E
rewind!
text: I tried to offer myself up as their plaything once or twice
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我试着主动献身，当他们的玩物，一两次吧，

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: but they were so cowed by my tazer that I ended up having to force them to rut.
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可他们怕我的电击枪，最后还得逼他们交配。

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: Have you ever even /thought/ of something so pathetic?
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你真有/想过/会有这么窝囊的事吗？

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: Space pirates that weren't even willing to sex up a willing fox...
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 堂堂太空海盗，连送上门的狐狸都不肯干……

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaA02D
rewind!
text: A few nights into trying to encourage these lizard brats to be more proactive
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我花了好几个晚上，想让这些蜥蜴崽子主动点，

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: and I basically had to give up on that idea.
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 结果，我基本只能放弃这个念头。

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: The most they were willing to do was steady themselves on my thighs
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们最多也就肯扶着我的大腿稳住身子

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: while they ate me out.
cut(0.06): AreaA02A
rewind!
text: A last ditch effort where I literally collared and leashed myself around them
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 最后我孤注一掷，真给自己套上项圈和牵绳，在他们身边转，

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: hoping one of them would yank me down and have their way with me
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 盼着谁能把我一把拽倒，任意玩弄我

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: turned out to be in vain...
text: Instead they just gingerly carried it around as if I were a queen or something!
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们反而小心翼翼地抬着它到处走，像把我当女王一样！

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): Black
rewind!
text: Hmm, Vickers... Queen of the space pirates...
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 嗯，维克斯……太空海盗女王……

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: That's a thought that I started to entertain, I'll admit!
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我承认，自己还真开始动这念头了！

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: If it weren't for stumbling into a fellow agent down one of these dark halls...
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 要不是在某条漆黑走廊里碰巧遇见另一位特工……

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaA02F
rewind!
text: I was about to give my salutations and show them the tricks my pets could do
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我正想打个招呼，让他们看看我宠物的拿手好戏

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: but this agent of ours just flashed their tazer on without saying a word!
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可咱这位特工二话不说，就亮起了电击枪！

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: It's almost like they weren't even listening, not to me nor the pirates...
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那位同事简直谁的话都不听，不听我的，也不听海盗的……

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: the pirates that screamed and turned tail, even without me giving an order!
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那些海盗尖叫着掉头就跑，都不用我下令！

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: I was about to be impressed with them having minds of their own, but...
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我正想夸他们终于有点主见了，可是……

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaA02G
rewind!
text: ...I was too busy getting my tail kicked!
text: Couldn't get a good look at whoever this silent agent was, but they were good.
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没看清那位一声不吭的特工是谁，不过身手真不错。

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: And maybe I'd grown a little sloppy, me and my fantasies of being a pirate queen.
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 也许我光顾着做海盗女王的美梦，有点松懈了。

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): Black
rewind!
text: Even so, after they knocked me out the mute usurper didn't stick around
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过，他们打昏我后，那个哑巴篡位者并没留下

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: I was left unceremoniously on the ground, to recover at my leisure.
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我被随手扔在地上，任我慢慢恢复。

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: ...
text: ...or so I thought...
cut(0.06): ClassicAgentB003FEMALE
rewind!
text: Those damn kobo curs took that opportunity to finally show some initiative!
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那些该死的科博杂种，偏在这时主动起来了！

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: With my energy sapped, they took to using me as their breeding toy
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我没了力气，他们就把我当成配种玩具来用

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: like I originally wanted them to!
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这本来就是我盼着他们干的！

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: Still, it seemed like a bit of a disappointment since I couldn't enjoy it 100%
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过，没法尽情享受，还是有点失望

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): Black
rewind!
text: They'd finally dumped me into this cell where I've recovered, and I was hoping
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 最后他们把我扔进这牢房，我缓过来了，还盼着，

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: that they'd come and try use me up again.
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们能再来把我狠狠干个够。

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: Instead, it's just a very late rescue. What a joke!
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 结果只是姗姗来迟的救援。真是笑话！

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: Well there you have it, debrief over. And if you'll excuse me...
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 好了，汇报完毕。没别的事，我就……

vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.source: text: ...I'll be on my way to find out where those lizard dogs are...
vsn/f_AgentF08/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……我得去找找那群蜥蜴狗在哪儿……

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: Golly! Thanks for saving me! Hasn't this all been pretty amazing?
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哇！谢谢你救我！这一切是不是超刺激？

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: No wonder they made all us rookies sign liability waivers before the mission!
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 难怪出任务前，要我们这些新人全签免责书！

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: I'd barely gotten used to wearing a spacesuit before I found myself in this mess.
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我连宇航服都刚穿惯，就摊上这烂摊子。

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: Shortly after landing on this planet far far away from my cozy desk chair...
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 才刚降落到这颗星球，离我舒服的办公椅远得不能再远……

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: I summarily found myself lost and alone, without even my mission files to read.
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 转眼我就独自迷路了，连任务档案都没得看。

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: It didn't take long before some sort of...of...VILLAIN cornered and disarmed me!
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没多久，一个……一个……恶棍就把我堵住，还缴了械！

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: Oh but that wasn't even the most shocking part, let me tell you...!
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可跟你说，这还不是最震惊的部分……！

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: I didn't even have time to put up a fight while this beast of a man had his way.
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这禽兽般的男人肆意蹂躏我，我连反抗都来不及。

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: Him and his gang did what they pleased, all I could do was give in to them.
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他和那帮同伙为所欲为，我只能任他们摆布。

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: I wish I could tell you more about them but I had my eyes shut the entire time!
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我也想多说些他们的事，可我全程都闭着眼！

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: Over and over I was taken; my ability to resist was sapped away all the while.
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我被一遍遍地干，反抗的力气也不断流失。

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: I'd never known these kind of sensations outside of training at the academy
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 除了学院训练，我从没体验过这种感觉

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: it all seemed like too much as I rode out the waves of pleasure forced upon me.
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 被强加的快感一波波袭来，我几乎承受不住。

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: Eventually I roused with a start to find the gang gone.
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 后来我猛地惊醒，才发现那帮家伙都走了。

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: Disoriented and unable to see, I crawled around looking for my glasses.
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我晕头转向，什么也看不清，只能到处爬着找眼镜。

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: But alas, it seemed like another cruel villain found me first!
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可惜啊，倒是另一个凶恶的坏蛋先找到了我！

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: This beast with his hungry eyes and large, strong paws, knew what he wanted.
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这野兽目光饥渴，爪子硕大有力，清楚自己想要什么。

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: Even now as I think of the way that prowl of monsters treated me...
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 直到现在，想起那群怪物怎样对我……

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: ...I...get a shiver down my...and inside my...
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……我……就会顺着我的……还有我里面……一阵发颤……

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: ...but the important thing is that I had enough energy and sense this time
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……重点是，这次我还有足够的精力和理智，

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: to stay alert to the way each raking barb of pleasure...went...ahh...!
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 留心每一根爽人的倒刺……刮过的……啊……！

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: It'll be impossible to forget these last few days.
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这几天的经历，想忘也忘不了。

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: Nothing in my training prepared me for this type of unbridled passion.
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 训练中学的一切，都不足以应付这种放纵的激情。

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: Day and night I was bred by these fierce creatures as though they were set
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这些凶猛的家伙日夜给我配种，仿佛铁了心

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: on having me bear their next litter.
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 让我生下他们的下一窝。

vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.source: text: ...and I can't wait to see what my next mission will be!
vsn/f_AgentF0B/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……我已经等不及想知道下一次任务了！

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Now, place your hands upon mine.
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): We, the Fenfen, have lived for eons on this planet that you know as "Tutone".
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们Fenfen，在这颗你们称为「图托恩」的星球上，已经生活了无数纪元。

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Having eschewed the sort of technological advances that your culture thrives on
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 摒弃了你们的文化赖以繁荣的那类技术进步之后，

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): we have lived simple, satisfying lives in harmony with the planet itself.
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们与这颗星球和谐共生，过着简单而满足的生活。

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Quiet and modest are the best ways to describe us Fenfen.
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 安静谦逊，最适合形容我们Fenfen。

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): All major quarrels were sorted out by a council of the wisest ESPers we had.
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 所有重大纷争，都由我们中最睿智的超能力者所组成的理事会来化解。

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): With our highly attuned senses and powers, we were able to find solutions that
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 凭借我们高度敏锐的感官与力量，我们总能找到解决之道，这些方案

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): benefitted all of society at once.
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 能让整个社会同时受益。

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): However, even with our attunement...
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 然而，即便有着这份感应力……

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...we were not able to sense that amongst us ESPers lay one whose ambitions
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……我们竟未察觉，超能力者之中藏着一人，其野心

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): would throw the very planet itself into chaos...
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 会将整颗星球本身都拖入混沌……

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Gifted beyond her years, with an uncanny ability to find solutions others missed
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 天赋远超其年纪，又有着总能找到他人所遗漏之解法的非凡本事，

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): the ESPer Traeh seemed like a fine addition to the council.
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 超能力者特蕾，看上去是议会的一位出色新成员。

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): She was readily granted access to the stores of power that we Fenfen kept.
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 她很轻易便获准接触我们Fenfen所封存的力量贮藏。

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Power... that she then proceeded to corrupt.
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 力量……而她随即着手将其腐化。

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Absorbing ancient caches of ESPer power that were left by previous generations
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 吸收了前代遗留下来的古老超能力者力量贮藏之后，

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Traeh was left deeply disfigured, down to her very core.
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 特蕾从外貌到内心，都已扭曲得面目全非。

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Maybe if we, the remaining elder ESPers of the council, reacted faster
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 也许我们议会中剩下的超能力者长老若能更快应对

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): then we could've prevented the calamity that was about to befall our people.
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 就本可以阻止那场即将降临到我们族人头上的灾难。

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Alas, we did not, and that will forever be our greatest failing...
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 可惜，我们没有，而这将永远是我们最大的过错……
lang(Fox): 去吧，命中注定的英雄。

vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Free my brothers and sisters and restore peace to the land!
vsn/f_AgentFZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 解放我的兄弟姐妹，让这片土地重归和平！

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Now, place your hands upon mine.
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): When Traeh turned her aggressions to us remaining members of the ESPer council
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 当特蕾把矛头转向我们超能力者议会的其余成员时，

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): it was unlike anything that we had ever encountered.
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 那是我们从未遭遇过的情形。

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): We were a peaceful, though perhaps squabbly, folk!
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们本是爱好和平的族群，虽说偶尔也爱拌拌嘴！

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Violence and ESPer powered aggression were unknown to us!
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 暴力，以及超能力者力量驱动的攻击，我们闻所未闻！

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Traeh was not alone in her new ambitions, however.
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 然而，怀有这番新野心的并非只有特蕾。

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Formerly placable creatures began to rise up as though answering her call.
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 向来温顺易处的生灵也纷纷起身，仿佛在响应她的召唤。

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Their combined powers were frightening...
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 它们汇聚起来的力量令人胆寒……

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...and it seemed as if all hope was lost!
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……而一切希望仿佛就此落空！

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): No amount of reason nor pleading would stop the newly emboldened creatures
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 无论讲道理还是苦苦哀求，都挡不住那些陡然壮了胆的生灵

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): and even our cries for mercy went unanswered.
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 连我们求饶的呼声也得不到半点回应。

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Those very cries seemed to only fuel Traeh's power and ambition even more.
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 那些哀嚎，似乎反而助长了特蕾的力量与野心。

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): With each new section of Tutone conquered she would set her eyes on another
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 每征服图托恩一片土地，她便盯上下一片，

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): until it seemed that the very planet itself would bend to her will.
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 直到仿佛整颗行星本身都要屈从于她的意志。

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Any Fenfen that couldn't hide in the shadows of what we once called home
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 任何无法躲进我们曾称之为家的阴影之下的Fenfen

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): became enslaved to do the bidding of the new conquerors.
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 都沦为奴隶，听命于新的征服者。

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): This was no longer a quiet and modest life for us...
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们的生活，再也谈不上安静谦逊了……

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Yes, our very home seemed destined to fall under the cruel fist of Traeh.
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 没错，我们的家园仿佛注定落入特蕾的残暴铁拳。

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): It was a level of cruelty that was unknown in the long history of us Fenfen
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 这种残酷在我们Fenfen的漫长历史上前所未见

vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): and it seemed as if all hope were lost...
vsn/f_AgentFZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 而一切希望仿佛都已不复存在……

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Now, place your hands upon mine.
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): As dark forces descended on all Fenfen, young and old alike,
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 当黑暗势力降临到全体Fenfen——无论老幼——头上时，

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): it truly did seem like all hope was lost.
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 一切希望看起来当真都已破灭。

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Powerful though the ESPers of our people may have been, violence was unknown to us.
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们族中的超能力者纵然或许强大，暴力对我们却全然陌生。

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Only when pushed to the end of options, when even surrender seemed impossible
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 只有当被逼至绝路，连投降似乎都变得不可能时，

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): did the first of us strike out...
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们中才有人第一个出手反抗……

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Psychic abilities once turned only towards a common good
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 曾经只用于共同福祉的心灵能力，

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): would now be turned against those who would try to subjugate us Fenfen!
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 如今要对准那些企图征服我们Fenfen的人！

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): An arsenal of ESPer abilities became harnessed as weapons of war.
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 超能力者的能力武库被征用为战争的武器。

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Explosive psychic projectiles blasted away foes.
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 爆裂的灵能弹将敌人轰退。

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Punishing waves of telekinetic force prevented advancement of armies.
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 一波波慑人的念动力浪潮，挡住了大军的推进。

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Some even went so far as to transform their very bodies into tools for combat.
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 有些人甚至走得更远，将自己的身体化作战斗的工具。

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Ancient beings heard the cries of mental anguish that rang throughout the planet
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 古老的存在们听见了回荡于整颗星球的精神痛呼，

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Some, like the noble Elves, took up ancient weapons in order to aid us Fenfen...
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 其中一些，比如高贵的Elves，拿起了古老的武器来援助我们Fenfen……

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...while other ancient beings, from deep within the bowels of the planet
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……而其他古老的存在，则从这颗星球最深的地底，

vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): awoke with a desire for vengeance and domination of their own...
vsn/f_AgentFZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 带着属于它们自己的复仇与征服欲望苏醒了……

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Now, place your hands upon mine.
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): The great war waged for years between the evil forces of Traeh
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 这场大战持续多年，交战双方是特蕾的邪恶势力

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): and the formerly peaceful Fenfen that inhabited this land.
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 与曾经和平、居住在这片土地上的Fenfen。

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): It seemed to all that this war might go on forever, with no decisive victories.
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 在所有人看来，这场战争或许会永远打下去，谁也无法取得决定性胜利。

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Without a vital member of the Fenfen council representing a vital force
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 议会失去了一位代表重要力量的 Fenfen 核心成员，

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): the remaining councilors were hamstrung.
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 余下的议员便处处受制。

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): The psychic bonds between the members still held, requiring constant vigilance
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 成员之间的灵能联结依然维系着，只是需要时刻保持警觉，

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): to keep dark forces from consuming more ESPers.
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 以免黑暗力量吞噬更多超能力者。

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...but then, one day, an opportunity arose...
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……可是有一天，一个机会出现了……

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): A moment of psychic weakness left Traeh disarmed and distracted for but a moment
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 心灵上的一时虚弱，让特蕾卸下防备、分了神，哪怕只有一瞬，

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): and in that moment the remaining members of the council struck!
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 就在那一刻，其余议员出手了！

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Unable to overcome the psychic disturbance and deal a final blow,
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 无法克服这股灵能扰动、给出致命一击，

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): the councilors instead froze Traeh in a crystal prison.
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 议员们转而将特蕾封冻在一座水晶囚牢之中。

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): With no fierce leader to guide them, the oppor- tunistic hordes broke apart
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 没有了凶悍首领的指引，那群见风转舵的乌合之众土崩瓦解，

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): fleeing from the powers of the Fenfen council.
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 纷纷逃离Fenfen理事会的力量。

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): This is not to say that it was a triumphant moment for the Fenfen...
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 这并不是说，对Fenfen而言这是一个凯旋的时刻……

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Indeed, heavy prices were paid on both sides of the conflict.
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 事实上，冲突的双方都付出了惨重的代价。

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): The planet you landed on is no longer the peaceful home of the Fenfen
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 你所登陆的这颗星球，已不再是Fenfen那宁静的家园，

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): but merely a chaotic shadow of its former self.
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 而只是往日模样的一个混沌残影。

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Many Fenfen as of yet are held captive by remnants of the would-be conquerors
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 至今仍有许多Fenfen被那些妄图征服者的残部俘虏着，

vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): awaiting the day that a hero will free them...
vsn/f_AgentFZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 等待着有朝一日，一位英雄前来解救他们……

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Now, place your hands upon mine.
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): As us Fenfen strove to rebuild our home and drive out the remnants of evil
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 当我们Fenfen奋力重建家园、驱逐邪恶残部时，

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): some of us looked up into the sky and saw a shooting star coming down.
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们中有些人仰望天空，看见一颗流星正坠落而下。

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Perhaps Fate had sent us a hero, with which we could regain our peace?
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 也许是命运给我们派来了一位英雄，好让我们重获和平？

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Or perhaps Fate had a more sinister joke to play on us suffering Fenfen
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 又或许，命运对受苦的我们Fenfen还有更阴险的玩笑要开，

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): for this visitor from the stars did not land on our planet proper...
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 因为这位来自群星的访客，并没有降落在星球本体上……

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...instead, they landed on the satellite rock that held Traeh's prison!
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……而是落在了关押特蕾的囚牢所在的那座卫星岩上！

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): As if destined for only a single purpose, the interstellar interloper
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 仿佛注定只有一个目的，那位星际闯入者

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): made their way to the very core of Traeh's prison.
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 一路来到了关押特蕾的囚牢核心。

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Had her psychic tendrils found their way into a poor fool's mind?
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 她的灵能触须，是否已经探入了某个可怜虫的脑中？

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): There is no way to know if it was dark ESPer power at work or merely curiosity
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 无从得知，究竟是黑暗的超能力者力量在作祟，还是仅仅出于好奇，

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): but this traveler made contact with the crystal prison that held Traeh...
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 但这位旅者确实触碰到了关押特蕾的水晶囚牢……

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...and so they became undone, unable to resist the dark ESPer forces.
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……就这样，这名旅者崩溃了，无力抵挡黑暗的超能力者力量。

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Power and pain coursed through the poor explorer
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 力量与痛苦奔涌过这名可怜的探索者全身，

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): until their mind was no longer their own.
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 直到那心智，再也不属于自己。

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): No, from that moment forth they answered to a darker power...
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 不，从那一刻起，其便听命于一股更黑暗的力量……

vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): They did as Traeh commanded!
vsn/f_AgentFZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 特蕾吩咐什么，其便做什么！

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Now, place your hands upon mine.
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Having touched the prison of Traeh, the interloper was no longer themself.
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 触碰到特蕾的囚牢之后，那名闯入者便不再是从前的自己。

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Enough dark psychic power had passed in that one moment of contact
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 就在接触的那一刻，已有足够多的黑暗灵能传递了过去，

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): that Traeh had a willing minion to send out into the wild.
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 特蕾也就有了一个甘愿效命的爪牙，可被差往荒野。

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): One by one, this twisted agent rounded up the remaining council members
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 这名被扭曲的代理人，把理事会余下的成员一个一个捉走，

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ensuring that the powers that kept Traeh imprisoned weakened more each day.
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 以此确保囚禁特蕾的力量一天天地衰弱下去。

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Even if the wise council members were intent on psychically detaining Traeh
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 即便睿智的议会成员决意以心灵之力拘禁特蕾，

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): after being subjugated to experiment after dark experiment...
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 在接连遭受一场又一场黑暗实验的摆布之后……

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...not even the wisest of Fenfen minds could wage battles on that many fronts.
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……即便是Fenfen中最智慧的头脑，也无法在如此众多的战线上同时作战。

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Without the powers of the Fenfen council to hold Traeh prisoner
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 一旦没有了Fenfen理事会的力量来囚禁特蕾，

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): it's only a matter of time before she's able to break free and wage war once more.
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 她破囚而出、再度开战，便只是时间问题。

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): And this time, there will be no resistance against her evil power.
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 而到了那时，将再没有任何力量能够抵挡她的邪恶之力。

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): The only thing that keeps this evil Queen from conquering all of Tutone
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 唯一让这邪恶女王尚未征服整个图托恩的，

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): is her desire to gain enough strength to transfer into a new host body.
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 是她想要积蓄足够的力量，转移到一个新的宿主躯体之中。

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Perhaps, then, it is another twist of Fate that sent you to this planet
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 那么，也许又是命运的一次转折，把你送到了这颗星球，

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): and had you arrive so near to where all this calamitous action took place.
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 并且让你来到距离这场灾难发生之地如此之近的地方。

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Will you be an even more powerful host for Traeh, Queen of Darkness?
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 你会成为黑暗女王特蕾更加强大的宿主吗？

vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Or will you be the saviour of the Fenfen, a beacon of courage and hope...?
vsn/f_AgentFZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 还是说，你会成为Fenfen的救主，一座勇气与希望的灯塔……？

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Whew! That was a pretty decent work out!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 呼！这运动量还真够劲！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Guess you were expecting a lesser agent again, huh?
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 看来你以为这次又是个不入流的特工，嗯？

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Unfortunately for you, you're not even the biggest lizard I've ever taken!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可惜啊，我上过的蜥蜴里，你还不算最大的！
text: ……不管是在战场上，还是床上！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: But nevermind that, lookee what we have here...
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过先不提那个，瞧瞧这是什么好东西……

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Finally got my lighttazer back!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 终于拿回我的光电击枪了！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Those darn little twerps must've squirrelled it away here.
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 肯定是那几个讨厌的小混蛋把它藏在这儿了。

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Hey, waitasec... This isn't mine! This looks like one that...
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哎，等等……这不是我的！看着像是……

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: ...some dumb little newbie would've dropped!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……某个蠢新手才会弄丢的东西！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Man oh man, I'd hate to be the trainee that dropped their first Lighttazer!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 天哪，弄丢第一把光电击枪的实习生可惨了！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: That's the kinda thing that gets you dragged in front of HR!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这种事可是会被人事部叫去训话的！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Thankfully, I'm far too elite to ever do something like that!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 幸好我这种精英，绝不会干那种事！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: ...left mine back at the ship? I think?
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……把我的落在船上了？大概吧？

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Anyways! No time to be concerned about such minor details.
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 总之！没空纠结这些小细节了。

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: It's time to progress with this research! For the good of all people!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 该推进研究了！为了所有人的福祉！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: But first, let's get rid of this pesky clothing.
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过先把这碍事的衣服脱了。

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Well, well, well! Looks like someone else is looking forward to the research too!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哎呀呀！看来还有人也很期待这场研究嘛！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Was worried that I was gonna have to keep you from running away or somethin'
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我还担心要拦着你，免得你逃跑什么的，

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: after the way you were putting up a fight there!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 毕竟你刚才还反抗得那么凶！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: You're a big boy, ain'tsh ya?
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你这大家伙，真够大的，对吧？

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Pretty shimilar to shome of the other kobold typesh I've been with, heh.
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 跟我玩过的其他几种科博德挺像的，嘿。

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Good ol' thick rod on you, with jusht a little bit of give to it
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你这根又粗又棒，还带着一点弹性

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: perfect for bobbing one'sh head up and down on!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 最适合让人含着，上下点头了！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: And even better yet for bobbing a cute pieshe of tail like mine o-
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 更适合让我这翘臀坐上去一颠一颠——

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: ...you're not even lishtening to me, are you?
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……你根本没在听我说，对吧？

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Don't pretend to shleep through all of thish! It'sh not gonna get you any
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 别装睡想混过去！唔，这可不会让你得到什么
text: 额外照顾的，唔，知道吗！！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Grrr, fine! Lesh shee you shleep shrough shome of these movesh!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 呜，行啊！看窝使出这几招，你还睡不睡得着！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: No way I zonked you out with one little punch!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不会吧，才轻轻一拳就把你打昏啦！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Mmmh, just a hint of shaltiness to you.
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 唔嗯，你尝起来有一丝咸咸的。

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: You koboldsh alwaysh have theshe fun little nubs on you.
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你们科博德身上总有这些好玩的小凸粒。

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: I can't help but want to take in the thicker onesh...
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 害我忍不住想把更粗的也含进去……

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Thaaaatsh it, I love the way they plop in and out <3
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 就——是这样，最喜欢它们噗嗤噗嗤地进出啦 <3

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: You're not very talkative, but your dick sheems to be shpeaking for ya
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你不太爱说话，鸡巴倒像是在替你开口，

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: and it'sh telling me to go harder and fashter!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 它正催着我再用力点、再快点呢！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: How long are you gonna pretend to be ashleep while I work you?
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我这么伺候着，你还打算装睡多久呀？

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Or maybe you're ackshually enjoying having a pro work their magic on ya.
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 又或许，你其实正享受专业人士给你施展绝活呢。

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: If you think that my little ol' mouth feelsh good, jusht you wait!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 要是觉得我的小嘴舒服，好戏还在后头！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: It ain't nothing compared to the wondersh you'll experienshe
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 跟你接下来要体验的妙处比，这根本不算啥，

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: ash shoon as the PROPER reshearche getsh shtarted!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 等真正的研究开始时！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Oh you liked that huh? I can feel you twitching away now.
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哦，你喜欢这样啊？都能感觉到你在抽动了。

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Feelsh like you're gonna get pushed over the edge ash shoon ash...
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 感觉只要一……你就要被推上高潮了……

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: ...mmh mh, that'sh it big boy!
text: Wow, you can really shoot can't ya?
text: Musht've been a while shince your last romp!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你肯定好久没干过一场了吧！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Still hard as a rock after that, huh?
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这样都还硬得像石头啊？

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Don't worry though, there's gonna be plenty more parts of me for you to
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过别担心，我身上还有好多地方等你来

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: fill up here, teehee! Gotta research you thoroughly and all that!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 灌满呢，嘻嘻！总得把你研究个透嘛！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Well well, look at that.
text: Guess you weren't playing at sleep after all, were you?
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 看来你还真不是装睡啊，是吧？

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: It's alright big fella, just lay back and let good ol' Yiffany here handl-
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没事，大个子，躺好，让这儿的老伊法妮来处——

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: What the heck? Where are you going??
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 搞什么？你要上哪儿去？？

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Gosh darnit!! You're just trying to make me look bad, aren't ya!!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 真该死！！你就是想让我出丑，对不对！！

vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Get that tail back here before I...!! Gah!!
vsn/f_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 把尾巴给我挪回来，不然我……！！啊啊！！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Well now, see what happens when you run away?
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 瞧吧，现在知道逃跑的下场了？

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Didn't mean to bonk you so hard, but were you trying to ruin my reputation
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不是故意敲那么重，可你是想砸我的招牌吗，

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: by running away before I could get some proper data on ya?
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我还没好好采集你的数据，你就想跑？

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: I tell ya, I used to spend soooo many hours practicing after class.
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 跟你说，我以前课后练习一练就是好——几个钟头。

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Signing out larger and larger training tools from the academy
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 从学院领用的训练道具也越来越大，

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: to the point where even some of my professors wondered if I was rushing too much!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 大到连几位教授都怀疑，我是不是练得太急了！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: In the end, it was all worth it though.
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过到头来，一切都值了。

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: When I graduated at only 22 years old, with honors, it was big news!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 才22岁就以优异成绩毕业，我当时可上了大新闻！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: I was the face of the PPPC's recruitment campaign and everything.
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我还当过PPPC招募宣传的代言人呢。

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Being the youngest agent to ever see active duty was craaaaazy intense.
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 作为史上最年轻的实战特工，压力简直大到爆。

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: ...even if my little brother managed to take that record from me...
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……虽然最年轻的纪录后来被我弟弟抢走了……

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: But no matter! That doesn't diminish my accomplishments one bit.
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过无所谓！这丝毫不损我的功绩。

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: And no feisty lizard is gonna diminish my reputation one bit, either!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 再凶的蜥蜴，也别想让我的名声受半点损伤！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Let's get this show on the road!
text: Not sure what it is about you big ol' overgrown lizards
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 真不懂你们这些长得过头的大蜥蜴是什么体质

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: but no amount of fighting ever makes you get soft, does it?
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可不管打得多凶，你们都不会软，对吧？

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: I swear! Sometimes it just seems to be like foreplay to you space pirate types!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 真受不了！对你们太空海盗来说，打架就像前戏！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: At least while you're dazed I can warm myself how I like to...
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 至少趁你还晕乎乎的，我能按自己喜欢的方式暖和暖和……

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Just gotta enjoy your tapered little tip for a bit before the REAL show starts.
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 正式开场前，先享受一下你尖尖的小龟头。

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Don't get me wrong, I could handle any of you wannabe badboys with noooo problem.
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 别误会，你们这些装坏小子的家伙，我收拾谁都轻——松。

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: But a girl's gotta have some nice and easy days too, you know?
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可姑娘也得过几天轻松日子，你懂吧？

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: We can't be all romp and pomp ALL the time!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 总不能一天到晚都闹腾着大干一场嘛！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Ahh there ya are, sleepy head! Finally managed to rouse the rest of you, huh?
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 啊，醒啦，小懒虫！你总算彻底清醒了？

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Don't you worry, I'll keep this lighttazer nice and saaafely turned off
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 别担心，我会让这把光电击枪安安——全全地关着

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: so long as you don't run. Deal?
