vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 只要你别跑。说定了？

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: That's what I thought, mmmh hmm!
text: You just... sit back and... mmmh... relax...
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你只要……靠着……嗯……放松……

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: While I show you what a... ahh! Cosmobreeder is all about!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 让我来教你……啊！宇宙育种者是干什么的！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Don't think I'll ever tire of the.... nnngh... nubs you have...
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你那些……嗯啊……小肉突，我怕是永远也玩不腻……

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: You darn space pirate lizards get all over the galaxy, but at the same time
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你们这些该死的蜥蜴太空海盗，整个银河都钻得遍，可同时

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: your gosh darn dicks are so good at getting all inside me, too...!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你们那该死的鸡巴，也特别会往我里面钻……！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: I have half a mind to complain about having to study you guys over and over
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 老得反复研究你们，我都想抱怨了，

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: but with those pleasurenubs built onto your dicks, I'll let it slide, hehe...
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过看在你们鸡巴上那些爽人凸粒的份上，就算啦，嘿嘿……

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: It's been a while since I've had one of you kobofolks grabbing onto my hips
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我有阵子没被你们科博德搂住胯了，

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: but if you insist on letting me take control this time...
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 但既然你坚持让我这次掌握主动……

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: ...then we're gonna have to ramp things up!
text: Warm up time is over, ya know!
text: Hey! Did you even hear me?
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 喂！你到底听见没有？

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Heh, guess this cosmotalent I have has left you just completely speechless.
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 嘿，看来我这宇宙级的本事，真让你一句话都说不出了。

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Dooooon't you worry though, I know exactly what I'm doing here.
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 别——担心，我很清楚自己在做什么。
text: 交给我这双巧手就放心吧！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Usually I like it when a man grabs me by the hips and helps out
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 平时我挺喜欢男人抓着我的胯，帮我一把

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: but I'll... hff... let you see what an agent can do on their own.
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过我……呼……要让你见识特工独自上阵的本事。

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Just this once, mind you!
text: Back in my academy days, I'd be riding up and down on training material
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 当年在学院，我可是骑着训练器材上下起伏，

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: that was twice as thick as you. Day after day!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 比你粗一倍。天天如此！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Boys do feel better... nmmm... after a bit of a break, though...
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过，歇一阵再跟男人做……嗯……确实更舒服……

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Oh, yeah, there we go...
text: I just gotta keep... ahh! Bumping that s-spot until...
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我只要继续……啊！顶着那、那里，直到……

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text:  A h h h h...!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text:  啊 啊 啊 啊……！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Now thaaaaat's what I like to f-feeeeel...!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这才是我喜、喜欢的感觉……！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: I told ya! There's no running away from me, hehehe!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 早说了！你逃不出我的手掌心，嘿嘿嘿！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: A girl's got a reputation to keep, and not even a nice handsome man like yourself
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 姑娘我还得维护名声，就算你又帅又讨喜

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: is gonna get away with trying to ruin it!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……想搞破坏，也别想全身而退！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: In fact, maybe I should teach you a lesson...
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 其实，我也许该给你个教训……

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Show you how much endurance a pro like me...
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 让你看看，我这样的专业人士，耐力究竟……

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: I was just kidding, you don't have to scramble off!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我开玩笑的，你不用慌忙逃走！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Aaaand you definitely didn't have to take the door out on your way, ow!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 还有，你走的时候真没必要连门都拆了，哎哟！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: You gotta be careful with those, you know. They're often load bearing!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那些可得当心点，知道吗？经常都是承重的！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Not even us agents will take out a door frame, because you run the risk of-
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 连我们特工都不拆门框，因为一不小心就——

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: -having the ceiling collapse on ya! Darn it!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ——被塌下来的天花板砸！可恶！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Not even gonna let me enjoy my afterglow before I have to rush around, huh?
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 连事后余韵都不让我享受，就得四处奔忙，是吧？

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Well I was hoping to dig around for more of my gear, but I guess I'll...
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 本想再翻翻，找些自己的装备，可看来我得……

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: ...wait a sec, what's that falling from up there...?
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……等下，上头掉下来的是什么……？

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: No way... I can't believe my luck!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不会吧……我的运气也太好了！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: I was just thinking about how useful a hyper bracer would be right about now!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我刚还在想，这会儿要是有个超能护腕可就太有用了！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: I'll be able to slide my way out of here in no time, heh!
vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我马上就能一路滑出这地方啦，嘿！

vsn/f_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: ...just let me grab my jacket again...

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: Some of you little folks have some proper fight in you... Heh!
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你们这些小个子里，有几个还挺能打……嘿！

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: I'd almost thought that the lot of you were merely an annoyance
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我差点以为，你们这些小东西只配惹人烦

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: but here's one that actually manged to hit me. Heh!
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没想到还真有个能打中我的。呵！

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: What's next, one of you coming along and knocking me down to-
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 接下来呢，你们还想来一个把我也撞——

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: Give me a break! I just got through smacking you up and down this cavern!
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 饶了我吧！刚才我才揍得你满洞窟乱窜！

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: I'm Cosmobreeder Yiffany, the best of the best!
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我是宇宙育种者伊法妮，精英中的精英！

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: For your information, I haven't shown you a fraction of my power!
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 告诉你，我连一丁点真本事都还没使出来！

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: What-!? How can you still move this fast after taking so many tazer blows?!
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 什、什么！？挨了那么多下电击，你怎么还这么快？！

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: Power...? My little yellow furred companion? You wish to speak of power?
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 力量……？黄毛小伙伴，你想谈力量？

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: Perhaps you'd like a lesson in just such a topic as "power"
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 或许，你想上一堂关于“力量”的课

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: and then you can recite it to me, no?
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 再由你背给我听，如何？

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: G-gonna stand up... again... any... any minute now...
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我、我马上……就又能……站起来了……

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: ...s-stand up and leave you be... I... mean... owch...
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……站、站起来就不打扰你了……我……是说……好疼……

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: Here, spunky yellow girl. Take your leave of my domain.
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 好吧，黄毛野丫头，离开我的领地吧。

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: And while you're at it, take this garbage that a fellow small fighter left
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 顺便，把另一个小个子战士留下的垃圾也带走，

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: after I had given him an even rougher lesson than yours.
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那次我给他的教训，比给你的还狠。

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: With shoes in hand, Yiffany scrambles out as the Redbull drops deeper into the mines
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 伊法妮拿着靴子爬出去，红牛则深入矿井

vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: his glowing red mane fading eerily into the dark...
vsn/f_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他泛着红光的鬃毛诡异地隐入黑暗……

vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: Hmf, getting a bit tired of this planet, and all you immortal beings on it...
vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哼，有点受够这颗星球，还有你们这些住在上面的不朽生灵了……

vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: No matter how many hits you take, you're still fresh as when I walked in here!
vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不管挨了多少下，你还是跟我刚进来时一样精神！

vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: Lemme guess, you're one of those immortal elves?
vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 让我猜猜，你也是那些不朽精灵中的一员？

vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: Correct, young lady. I am Enelye, the Immortal High Lady of the Tutone Elves.
vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没错，年轻的女士。我是恩内莉，图托恩精灵的不朽至高女领主。

vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: I must commend your most respectable performance in the art of combat
vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你在战斗技艺上的表现令人肃然起敬，我必须予以赞扬，

vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: it was a highly enjoyable act to watch, even for one as old as I.
vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 即便对我这样年长的人而言，观赏这场表演也十分愉快。

vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: It was so enjoyable, that I believe you are due for a reward.
vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 实在是太令人愉快了，我想你理应得到一份奖励。

vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: So please, sit back and relax while I...
vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以，请坐好，放松下来，让我……

vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: Woah! W-wait a minute, L-lady Enelye...! I'm here to *save* your-
vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哇！等、等一下，女、女领主恩内莉……！我是来*拯救*你的——

vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: ...really!? I can do this myself!
text: Wa-hey! Actually, I'm usually not a dress-girl... but this feels really nice!
vsn/f_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哇哦！其实我平时不怎么穿裙子……不过这感觉真不错！

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: lang(HardFox): Thou hast fought a fair round for such an untrained hand.
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(HardFox): 汝虽未受操练，这一战倒也打得不赖。

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: lang(HardFox): Pray, tell me thine name so that I may honor thee.
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(HardFox): 敢问阁下尊姓大名，好让吾致以敬意。

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: lang(HardFox): ...ahh, but the people of thy land do not speaketh my tongue...
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(HardFox): ……啊，然汝故土之人不通吾语……

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: What gives?! All the punishment I'm dishing out...
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 搞什么？！我下了这么多狠手……

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: ...only seems to make you stronger?! What ARE you?!
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……反倒只让你越来越强？！你到底是什么东西？！

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: lang(HardFox): I need not speaketh your crude tongue in order to understand your crude desire
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(HardFox): 无需通晓汝之粗鄙言语，吾亦明了汝之粗鄙欲求。

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: lang(HardFox): So struggle not as I placeth a most useful trinket upon thee.
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(HardFox): 故而莫要挣扎，待吾为汝戴上这实用的小饰物。

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: No way! You can't just snap a collar on me like I'm some... some kind of pet!
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不行！不能就这么给我扣上项圈，当我是……是什么宠物！

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: Me... and the other Cosmobreeders! We'll make you regret this!
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我……还有其他宇宙育种者，会让你后悔的！

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: And how shalt thou do that, fairest knight?
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 最美的骑士啊，汝打算如何做到？

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: Mine powers are ancient and forgotten, and thou are but a pup lost in the dark.
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 吾之力量古老且已被遗忘，汝不过是暗夜迷途的幼犬。

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: Prayeth that I overlook your ill mannered outburst, as the generous host I am.
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 祈求吾以宽宏主人之身，不计较汝方才的无礼罢。

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: Now taketh this necklace so that you may understand others of this land
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 且收下这项链，好让汝听懂此地众人的话语

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: ...and spareth them from your ill manners...eh heh heh heh...
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……也免得汝再对他们无礼……呵呵呵呵……

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: And with a gutteral laugh, the demonic form faded back into the darkest darks
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 随着一阵低沉的笑声，那恶魔身影退回最深的黑暗，

vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: leaving nought but a scared pup in his wake...
vsn/f_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 只留下一只吓坏的小狗……

vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: Ugh! What is it with you little pipsqueaks?
vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 呃！你们这些小不点到底是怎么回事？

vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: First you pillage my belongings, then you try to attack me?
vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 先是洗劫我的东西，接着又想来攻击我？

vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: Well, you've got another thing coming, you little bra-
vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 好啊，你们可想错了，你这个小混-

vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: It's my standard issue Cosmohelm! I've been looking for this since I landed!
vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这就是我的标配Cosmohelm！我一落地就在找它！

vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: That brat must have squirrelled it away down here!
vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 一定是那个小鬼把它偷偷藏到这下面来了！

vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: This is perfect! If I can find my whole suit, I'll be able to go space-walking!
vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 太完美了！如果我能找齐整套装备，就能去太空漫步了！

vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: ...or at least traverse some low oxygen areas...
vsn/f_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……或者至少能穿行于一些低氧区域……

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: Now... Yiffai, you're gonna have to wake up for me!
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 现在……伊法伊，你一定要醒过来啊！

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: If you're not still in there... I don't, I don't know what I'd do!!
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 要是你已经不在里面了……我不，我不知道该怎么办！！

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: Uuhn... big sis... I remember you...
text: In fact, getting knocked to the darn ground like this again...
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 说真的，又像这样被狠狠打倒在地……

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: ...is makin' me remember you even more.
text: Like when we used to tussle... heh, you never did gimme a break...
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 就像以前我们打闹的时候……嘿，你可从来没让过我……

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: ...my tough big sis, who taught me everything... and always looked out for me...
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……我那厉害的姐姐，什么都教给了我……也一直护着我……
text: 伊法伊……你、你回来了！

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: I can't believe it... I thought... I thought I might have to...
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 真不敢相信……我以为……我以为自己可能不得不……

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: But now you're safe again!
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过现在你又安全了！

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: Nnf... might need a little help standing.
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 唔……可能得扶我一把才能站起来。

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: That beating you dished out was one thing... but that's not all...
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你把我揍成这样是一回事……但还不止如此……

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: I was under the control of... a queen. Dark and cruel.
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我之前被……一位女王控制着。她阴暗又残忍。

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: Feels like she sapped most of the energy I had left, when her will left me.
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 感觉她的意志离开我时，把我剩下的大半力气也抽走了。

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: I might not be able to swing a tazer for a while... but here, take this.
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我可能有一阵子挥不动电击枪了……不过，来，拿着这个。

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: It's dad's old whistle. You gave it to me for my first mission, remember...?
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这是爸爸的旧哨子。我第一次出任务时，你把它给了我，还记得吗……？

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: I'll pilot your ship, and wherever you blow the whistle, I'll pick you up!
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我来驾驶你的飞船，不管你在哪儿吹响哨子，我都会去接你！

vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: That's the least I can do for saving me, right...?
vsn/f_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你救了我，这至少是我该做的，对吧……？

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Allllriiiight big boy, had enough yet? You've finally calmed down!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 好啦，大个子，闹够没？总算安静了！

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Just sit back while I show you what Cosmo- breeding is all about.
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 乖乖躺好，让你见识什么叫宇宙育种。

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Gotta get my favorite jacket off so it doesn't get dirty and th-
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 得先脱掉我最爱的夹克，免得弄脏，然后——

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Ow what? What are you doing you big goof?
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哎哟，什么呀？你这大傻瓜想干嘛？

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: You don't want me to kick your tail AGAIN, do ya?
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你总不想再被我一尾巴踹过去吧？

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: So back down before I... Before I...
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以赶紧退下，不然我……不然我……

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: ...oooh, you just wanted to get a head start, didn't ya boy?
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……哦，你就是想抢先开干，对吧，狗狗？

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: It was beginning to feel like nobody on this planet wanted to rut!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我都快以为这星球上没谁想交配了！

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Thankfully you seemed to have read my mind <3
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 幸好你好像看透了我的心思 <3

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: R-real eager, ain't ya? Watch those claws!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 还、还真心急啊你？当心爪子！

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Don't wanna be running around freeing other agents on this planet
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我可不想满星球跑着救其他特工时

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: with my legs all scratched up.
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 两条腿都被抓得一道道的。

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: It's practically indecent to show off like that!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这么显摆，简直有伤风化！

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Theeere you go, finally hitting the target <3 <3
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 对——就是这样，终于射中靶心啦<3 <3

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Don't be afraid to fill me up, I always carry some Estrafin on me!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 放心把我灌满吧，我随身都带着 Estrafin！

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: So even if we're species compatible I won't get knocked up.
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以就算物种相容，我也不会怀孕。

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: ...or, I did, until my gear got stolen.
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……至少，装备被偷前是这样。

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: B-but I'm sure I could find some again, on the very slim chance
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不、不过肯定还能再弄到些，万一那微乎其微的可能成真，

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: that we happen to be perfect to make a baby together!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 咱俩恰好完全合得来，能一起生个宝宝！

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Aww, what's wrong, turn you off? At this rate your knot won't tie inside of me...
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哎呀，怎么了，扫兴啦？这样你的肉结可锁不住我……

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: ...hold on there, you're gonna keep on thrusting? What a GOOD boy!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……等等，你还要继续插？真是乖狗狗！

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Nnnf, who taught you how to do this little trick, huh?
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 嗯呃，谁教会你这小花招的，嗯？

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: I gotta thank them, whoever they are. Most ferals stop once the knot swells up.
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不管是谁教的，我都得谢谢。多数野性兽人一涨起肉结就停了。

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: D-damn... you're r-really stirring me up now...
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可、可恶……你真把我搅、搅得欲火焚身了……

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Gotta admit that I was looking forward to a tie, but with how good you thrust
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不得不说，我本来还盼着锁结，可你插得这么爽，

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: this is a preeeetty good consolation prize!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这份安慰奖也真是相当不错！

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Just gotta give you another moment or two, and maybe some of that doggy cream
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 再给你一小会儿，说不定那些狗狗精液，

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: will rub off in me!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 就能蹭进我里面了！
text: ……还是蹭进去、蹭出我身体？

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Whatever! Just k-keep at it, stud!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 随便啦！继、继续，猛男！

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Uh w-wait... You aren't getting... thicker, are you?
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 呃，等、等等……你不会……在变粗吧？

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: That's actually getting a bit rough now, h-hey!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 现在可有点太粗暴了，喂、喂！

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Settle down a bit boy! Gimme a second!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 冷静点，小子！让我缓口气！

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: D-damn it! I thought your knot was out already? If you keep thrusting like that
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 该、该死！我还以为你的肉结早就胀起来了呢？再这样顶下去

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: then y-you might press into my...
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那、那你就可能顶进我的……

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Oh... ohmygosh... y-you really did get thicker...
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哦……天哪……你、你还真变粗了……

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: D-damn, what a breeder...<3 my turn to catch my breath... huff...
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 该、该死，真是配种猛将……<3 轮到我喘口气了……呼……

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Y-yeah that's it, just settle down a bit while I... ahh!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 对、对，就是这样，先安分点，让我……啊！

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Your knot's so good that it makes me glad I didn't waste my time
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你这肉结太舒服了，真庆幸之前没浪费时间

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: on that other little blue furred pupper pipsqueak earlier!
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: on that other little blue furred pupper pipsqueak earlier!

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [My dear "Yiffany", it's only thanks to the fact that you left my son alone]
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [亲爱的“伊法妮”，只因你没对我儿子下手，]

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [that I decided to play along with your little round of roughhousing.]
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [吾才决定陪汝玩一场小小的打闹。]

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [Please, have a mere taste of what an Esper like me is capable of!]
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [来，稍稍领教一下我这样的超能力者有何本领！]

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [That's right my dear, you are indeed now a feral yourself.]
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [没错，亲爱的，你现在确实也成了兽形。]

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [Now please forgive me for "wasting your time"...]
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [那么，请原谅我要“浪费你的时间”了……]

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [...as I put your body to the test so that you may grow accustomed to it...]
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [……我要考验一下你的身体，好让你习惯这副模样……]

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Th-there... I'm finally back on two legs again...
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 好、好了……总算又能两条腿站着了……

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: A-and that big fellar ran off somewhere, s-so now I can...
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 而、而且那大家伙也跑没影了，这、这样我就能……

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: ...I can make a break for it... ow...
text: Gee papa, are you sure that yellow dog lady is really the chosen one?
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 爸爸，你确定那位黄毛狗女士真是天选之人吗？

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: That lady, Yiffany, mastered one of the Zener powers in record time
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那位伊法妮女士，以破纪录的速度掌握了一种泽纳之力

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: so I have no doubt that she will be the one to set this planet free.
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以我深信，她就是解放这颗星球的人。

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: That sounds so cool! She's a real superhero, isn't she dad?
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 听着好酷！她真是超级英雄，对吧，爸爸？

vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: I wish I could train with her next time. Can I dad? Can I??
vsn/f_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 下次真想跟她一起训练。爸爸，可以吗？可以吗？？

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Well! You're a feisty little fella, aren't ya? You almost did some damage there
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 嚯！小家伙还挺有劲啊？刚才差点就伤到我了

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: with all that running and jumping you were doing!
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 就凭你刚才那阵又跑又跳！

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: But who could be angry after seeing your cute lil face, awwwww!
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过看你这可爱的小脸，谁还气得起来啊，哎哟！

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Little pups like you are so perky and energetic! I bet you're almost ready for
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你这样的小狗崽真是活泼有劲！我猜你已经快准备好

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: another round of tussling already, aren't you?
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 再打一场了，是不是？

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: That's how I was too, when I graduated from the Cosmobreeder program
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我当年从宇宙育种者培训班毕业时，也是这样

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: and went on my very first mission at the young age of only 22...
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 年仅22岁，就踏上了头一次任务……

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Back then, I was a clumsy lil bitch, I tell ya. Managed to lose all my gear
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 告诉你，那时我就是个笨手笨脚的小母狗，装备都弄丢了

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: except for my tazer, before I even had a chance to gather some data!
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 就剩电击枪还在，连收集数据的机会都没捞着！

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: ...completely different from now, when I always manage to keep my jacket on.
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……跟现在完全不同，我现在总能保住外套不脱。

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: It was a bit of a shock seeing my first space pirate Kobold in person.
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 头一次亲眼见到科博德太空海盗，真有点吃惊。

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: They're way more aggressive and nimble in person than the simulations showed
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 真家伙比模拟里的凶猛、灵活多了

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: or maybe it was the adren- aline pumping through me that made it seem that way.
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 也可能只是肾上腺素飙升，让我有这错觉。

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Either way, it didn't take long...
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不管怎样，没过多久……

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: ...for the Kobold to be pumping through me too!
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……科博德也要在我体内猛冲了！

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: I can't even recall getting disarmed and being pushed up against a wall.
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我都不记得自己怎么被缴械、推到墙上的。

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: The details of my very first live data collection are crystal clear though.
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 但头次实地采集数据的细节，我记得一清二楚。

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: That Kobold's thick tail slapping at the ground every time he thrust in...
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那科博德每次插入，粗尾巴都会拍打地面……

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: ...while my poor cheek fur got all tussled up from being pushed into the wall!
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……我可怜的脸颊毛被顶在墙上，蹭得乱七八糟！

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Unlike the training back home, the real fellas don't wait for you to get comfy.
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 跟家里的训练不同，真家伙可不等你先适应舒服。

vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: But! I'm a quick learner and began rocking my body along with the stud.
vsn/f_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过！我学得可快了，立刻就跟着那猛男晃动身子。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: D-darn, that was a harder bump than I expected. Wasn't ready for that...

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: Alright, lights are dimming. No more jokes, only naptimezzz....

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: Being woken up by a Kobold NOT fucking me, that's a new one!

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: This must be the first time I've seen a Kobold try to be gentle with me

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: bad luck for him though, since I'm the kinda bitch that likes things ruffer!

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: Yeeeaaaaa-a-a-h, this kind of gentle frolicking just isn't doing it for me.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 是——啊——，这么温柔地玩耍，实在满足不了我。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: I mean, he's doing me, and that's great and all I guess...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我是说，他是在干我，也确实挺舒服啦……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: but dammit, those nubs on his dick are meant to be shoved in and out of me
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可真是的，他鸡巴上的凸粒，就该往我里面来回捅

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: vigorously, with complete disregard for my health!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 狠狠地来，根本不管我的死活才对！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: Oh come on, even his friends are all soft and gentle? What the heck!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不是吧，连他朋友也都这么轻柔温和？搞什么！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: Are they trying to start a new trend or something? I'm not for it, lemme tell you.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们想引领什么新潮流吗？跟你说，我可不买账。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: A girl like me with 4 lizard dicks at her disposal...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 像我这样的姑娘，手边有四根蜥蜴鸡巴任我用……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: I should be climaxing non-stop, before moving onto even bigger conquests!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我就该高潮个不停，再去征服更大的家伙！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: ...whatever, let's see how many of these guys I can take care of at once...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……算了，看我一次能应付他们几个……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: ...alright! That's all taken care of!
text: Those gentlemen lizards didn't even bother chaining me up after. Booooring!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那些蜥蜴绅士完事后，连把我锁起来都懒得。无——聊！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: But now that I'm done with them, time to get dressed and head out of here.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过既然跟他们玩完了，也该穿好衣服离开了。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: Time to find something that can give me a proper rut after tha-
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 接下来得找个能好好操我一顿的，在那——

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: -AAAAH! Hey! Where the heck did you beasts come from?
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: —啊啊！喂！你们这些野兽从哪冒出来的？

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: I'm happy to see you guys too, but let me stretch before you jump on m-
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 见到你们我也很高兴，可扑过来前先让我伸个懒—

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: -AACK! Let go of my jacket!
text: These Barkers are real agg- ressive, making up for those Kobolds, big time!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这些吠犬可真凶猛，把那群科博德欠的劲全补上了！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: Usually I'd smack around punks like this a bit so I could stay in control
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 平时我会先揍这种混蛋几下，好掌握主动

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: but after all that teasing that the Kobold group accomplished
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可被那群科博德好一通挑逗之后
text: 我觉得身上莫名燥热……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: D-damn!!! Why does it feel so HECKING good this time?!?
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 该、该死！！！这次怎么他妈的这么爽？！？

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: It's like this canid dick w-was meant for me... ohmygosh...!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这犬科鸡巴简、简直就是为我生的……天哪……！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: ...way too intense... need... n-need to shtop it beforrRRrRrgrrrr...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……太激烈了……得……得在那之前停下……RRrRrgrrrr……
text: ……不行……              ……太 舒 服 了……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: I can't stahp cuh- cuh- cuhliIIIimakshingggGGaah!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 停不下了，一、一直高——潮啊啊啊！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: After blacking out from the first round of Barkers, I am now chained in a cell
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 被第一拨吠犬弄晕过去后，我现在被锁在牢里

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: after some Kobold Slavers grabbed me when I was in no condition to fight.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 几个科博德奴隶贩子趁我无力反抗，把我抓了。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: Many moons have passed, and escape might be possible, but...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 过了许多个日夜，也许能逃走了，可是……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: ...the slavers let me spend time with the Barkers every day, hehe...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……奴隶贩子每天都让我跟吠犬待在一起，嘿嘿……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: ...n-no! No distractions, m-must continue report.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……不、不行！别分心，得、得继续报告。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: At some point during my captivity, some local big-eared fauna stopped by
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 被关期间，有几个当地的大耳朵生物来过

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: it seemed like they were freeing prisoners, and were about to let me go...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们像是在解救囚犯，正准备放我走……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: ...before the leader of the group recognized that I'd much rather stay <3
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……直到领头的发现，我其实更想留下来 <3

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: They might've had a fight on their hands if they tried to drag me away from here.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们要敢把我拖走，我说不定还真会动手呢。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: Since the Barker kennels weren't going anywhere, neither was I!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 吠犬的狗窝又不会跑，我也哪儿都不去！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: And that's how my time on Tutone seems to have ended up.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 看来，我在图托恩的经历就这样收场了。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: Maybe eventually another agent will come along so I can report this properly
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 也许总有别的特工来，好让我正式汇报，

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: but until then, I heard that I'm going up for auction pretty soon!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过在那之前，听说我很快就要被拍卖啦！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: I just hope it's a 2-for-1 deal for me and a Barker or two... or ten... heh...!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 只希望能搭售，买我送一两只吠犬……或十只……嘿……！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 说真的？我出过那么多任务，要是这样，我反倒会觉得有点受辱：

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: breed you and not *eat* you. I could already tell I was safe, though.

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: The Gobin didn't speak my language, but from all his snorting and groping...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那哥布林不懂我的话，可他哼哼着，又摸又捏……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: How the hell do boy agents walk straight after getting it like this all night?!

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Not that it wasn't kinda *fun* being passed around and used like an onahole.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 倒也不是说，被传来传去、像当飞机杯那样用，不*好玩*。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: 'Figured I'd let them have their fill of filling me, then slip away that night...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 本想着让他们灌我灌个够，当晚再偷偷溜走……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……可后来我明白了，哥布林不会轻易放我走。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Watching wasn't the *only* thing they did day and night, either! I think every
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们日夜不停做的，可不*只是*看守！我觉得每个

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Gobin in Sceafya must have fucked me in both holes! I barely had time to sleep! <3

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: After seeing all those other girls caged and ruffed up, I'd kinda been hoping
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 看到别的姑娘被关进笼子、折腾得够呛，我也有点盼着

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: to get in a bit of trouble like that too... and well, these Gobins delivered...

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Each night they threw me back into my cage, I barely had the strength to stand!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 每晚被扔回笼子时，我连站起来的力气都没了！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: I spent two weeks aching, trembling, and leaking like a trainee, heh...

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: This was definitely the most intense 'forced vacation' I'd ever experienced!

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我知道迟早得逃。这是出任务，又不是上岸休假……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...and nobody was coming to break me out, either.

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Damn though, that Gobinventure really took a lot out of me, and I wasn't
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 该死，那场哥布林历险真把我榨干了，我可不想

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: relishing having to start my mission over from square one...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 乐意把任务从头再来一遍……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCH
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCH

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...but as fate would have it, I didn't have to.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……不过命运眷顾，我倒不用费那个心了。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: 'Are you lost, little one?' The tall Elf lady asked me.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: “迷路了吗，小家伙？”高挑的精灵女士问我。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: I quickly retorted that I wasn't some little pup, but she wasn't listening!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我立刻反驳说我才不是什么小狗崽，可她根本不听！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: As weak as I was, I didn't have much choice but to go with her. Hmf!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我太虚弱，除了跟她走也没别的办法。哼！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCI
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCI

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: I was captive again! Though... the elves... made it a lot more relaxing...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我又被俘了！不过……那些精灵……让人放松多了……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: After all that rough sex and sleeping on the hard floor of my cage for weeks
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 被粗暴地干了几周，又一直睡笼子的硬地板后

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: it was pretty nice to get a bath...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 能洗个澡真是舒服……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...even if those Elf ladies made my boobs feel a bit small...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……虽然跟那几位精灵女士一比，我的奶子显得有点小……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCJ
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCJ

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: But during my bath, I started to feel a little bit *too* relaxed.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可泡着泡着，我开始觉得有点*太*放松了。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Like I'd been drugged, or... or something...?
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 像被下了药，或……或是什么……？

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: I tried to scamper away when I noticed, but my head swam and my legs were jelly.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 发觉不对后我想赶紧溜，可脑袋发晕，双腿软得像泥。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: One of the Elf ladies pinned me to a rock in their bathing spring... and...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 一位精灵女士把我按在浴泉的岩石上……然后……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...oh god... just went down on me... and I just *melted* for her...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……天啊……直接舔起我的下面……我都为她*化了*……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCK
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCK

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: I had a hard time staying focused for a while, after that...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那之后，好一阵子我都很难集中精神……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: The Elf ladies kept cooing at me. 'Shh. Just relax, puppy... good girl.'
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 精灵女士们不停柔声哄我：“嘘，放松，小狗……乖女孩。”

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Without the strength to resist their training, I simply did as I was told...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 无力反抗她们的调教，我只能乖乖听话……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...and the more I obeyed, the better it felt...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……而我越听话，就越舒服……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCL
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCL

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Now that I've collected my thoughts, everything has become totally clear.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 如今理清思绪，一切都彻底明白了。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: It was foolish for me, a dumb little puppy, to think I could save the planet...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我这只笨小狗，竟以为能拯救星球，真傻……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: My place is to follow along quietly and to serve my mistresses.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我只该乖乖跟着，服侍我的女主人们。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): Black
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): Black

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: If you're watching this, know that the galaxy is in safe hands now.
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 若你正看着这段记录，请放心，银河如今有人守护了。

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Trust in the proud Elf rangers of Sceafya and their wise leader...
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 请相信斯凯菲亚骄傲的精灵游侠，以及睿智的领袖……

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Her peerless grace, my queen! High Lady Enelye!
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 风华无双的陛下，我的女王！恩内莉大人！

vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: wait: 0.2
vsn/f_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: wait: 0.2

vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [Agent Yiffany did not return from her mission on Planet Tutone.]
vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [伊法妮特工未从图托恩星的任务中归来。]

vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [She was last active on EXILE, a small asteroid orbiting the planet.]
vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [她最后在流放地活动，那是绕该星球运行的小行星。]

vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [Based on her final recordings, it is unlikely that the agent survived...]
vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [根据最后的录音判断，该特工生还的可能性极低……]

vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [...but, as no remains have been recovered, her precise fate remains unclear.]
vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [……但尚未寻获遗骸，她的确切命运仍不明。]

vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [All agent communications from Tutone have since ceased.]
vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [自此，来自图托恩的全部特工通讯均已中断。]

vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [Our mission logs indicate that some dark 'queen' might be in search of]
vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [任务日志显示，某位黑暗“女王”可能正在寻找]

vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [a new host body, and may be seeking to expand her influence beyond Tutone...]
vsn/f_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [新的宿主躯体，并可能企图把势力扩张到图托恩之外……]

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: [STARDATE XXXX:XXXX:XXXX.XX] [PLANET TUTONE, 5555 SYSTEM] [MAGNETOSHEATHE ENTRY POINT]
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [星历 XXXX:XXXX:XXXX.XX] [5555星系，图托恩星] [磁鞘进入点]

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: ...entry successful, en route to descend at 40N, 74W in T-minus XXXX unisecs.
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……成功进入，正前往北纬40、西经74，距下降还剩XXXX标准秒。

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Engine temp stable at 2640 degrees, plasma, oxygen and battery levels good.
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 引擎温度稳定在2640度，等离子、氧气和电量均正常。

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: This is Cosmobreeder Yiffany, can I get a mission update, Bossu?
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这里是宇宙育种者伊法妮。Bossu，能更新下任务情报吗？

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: That's commanding officer Bossu, Yiffany. Don't forget that!
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 要叫Bossu指挥官，伊法妮。别忘了！

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: We here at HQ are all thankful that you took this mission on short notice.
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 总部上下都很感谢你临时接下这次任务。

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Oh yeah, no problem! If my little bro is all tangled up in it like you say he is
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 当然，没问题！要是我弟真像你说的那样卷进去了，

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: then I wouldn't miss being the one to rescue him for the world!
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那救他的机会，我说什么也不会错过！

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: It's sad that your brother Yiffai was introduced to Cosmobreeding this way
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你弟弟伊法伊竟以这种方式接触宇宙育种，令人遗憾

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: but there were more experienced agents on the same mission as he was.
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可同一趟任务里，还有比他更有经验的特工。

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: You know the drill. Your mission is to gather as much useful bio data as you can
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 规矩你懂。任务是尽量收集有用的生物数据

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: while also attempting to find your missing fellow agents, wherever they are.
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 同时设法找到失踪的特工同伴，无论他们身在何处。
text: 只要确……保……你……多加……小……心……

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Mewahaha! What's this? Another little spacebug entering my domain?
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 喵哈哈！怎么，又有小太空虫闯进我的领地了？

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Enjoy your crash landing like your other little interlopers did, puppy!
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 小狗，跟先前那些小入侵者一样，好好享受坠机吧！

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: What? Just who the heck are you?
text: And where the heck did all these ships come from?
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 还有，这些飞船到底打哪儿来的？

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Alright this is a little ruffer than I was expecting!
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 好吧，这可比我预想的颠得厉害！

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: If you can hear me Bossu my engine's been hit! Making emergency descent!
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: Bossu，听见了吗？引擎中弹！正在紧急下降！

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Well, I guess that's what I get for not taking things serious up there.
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 唉，这大概就是我在上头掉以轻心的报应。

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Gotta remember that there were some experienced agents that went missing
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 得记住，失踪的还有好些经验丰富的特工

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: not just my baby bro!
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 失踪的可不止我家小弟！

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: This ol' ship should be good to go for low orbit maneuvers at least.
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这老飞船至少还能在低轨道上机动。

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: I oughtta get more than just my flight jacket on, and maybe take a look around...
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我该多穿点，不能光披飞行夹克，再四处看看……

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: What the heck do you think you're doing you little thief?!?
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你这小贼，搞什么鬼呢？！？

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Seriously? Escaping down some dingy dark little hole?
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不是吧？竟然钻进又脏又黑的小洞逃跑？

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Maaaan, this is NOT how I like my missions to start out!
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 天哪，我可不想任务一开始就这么倒霉！

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Some big breasted punk and her floozies shooting me down...
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 先是大奶混混和她那帮骚货把我击落……

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: ...and then some little brat stealing my gear!
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……接着又有个小混蛋偷走了我的装备！

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Whatever, this is as good a place to start exploring as any.
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 管它呢，从这儿开始探索也没什么不好。

vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Who knows, maybe there'll be some interesting creatures to find down here too!
vsn/f_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 谁知道呢，说不定下面也有些有趣的生物可找！

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: I told you I could handle this myself! Hey, at least stop watching, alright?!
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我说了自己能搞定！喂，至少别盯着看了，行吗？！

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: Hmf, this is all because I took a posting on this stupid backwater planet.
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哼，都怪我接了这颗破偏远星球的差事。

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: My friends all took missions to a pleasure planet, but I just had to take this
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 朋友们都接了去享乐星的任务，我却偏要接这趟

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: Tutone sortie. The recruiter said that most species here were half my height!
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 图托恩任务。招募员说这儿多数物种才我一半高！

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: Well, the first thing my dumbass squad leader did was try to go all rapebo on
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我那蠢货队长一上来，就想当个强奸兰博，硬上

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: a group of kobolds. Those things are definitely NOT half my height!
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 一群科博德。那些家伙可绝对不止我一半高！

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: Didn't see him after that, but eventually the kobolds caught up with me, too...
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 后来就没再见到他，可最后科博德也追上了我……

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: They thought I was a barker! Like, what?! We don't look alike at all!
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们以为我是吠犬！搞什么？！我们一点都不像！

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: My squad had some run-ins with those things, before we all got separated.
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我们小队走散前，跟那些东西打过几次照面。

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: It was a big joke with the others, the way barkers kept goin' for my tail.
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那些吠犬老冲着我屁股来，其他人拿这事笑个不停。

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: I was NOT gonna go in that cell without a fight, but kobolds are so strong...
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我才不会乖乖进牢房，可科博德力气太大……

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: By the time the kobolds got me inside, I was aching all over, exhausted.
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 科博德把我带进去时，我已浑身酸痛、精疲力竭。

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: I tried to keep the barkers at bay by kicking and making a lot of noise.
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我又踢又嚷，想让那些吠犬别靠近。

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: But the pack got bolder. Soon enough they surrounded me, nipping at my fur.
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可那群家伙越来越大胆，很快围住我，啃咬我的毛。

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: I knew what I was in for if I let my guard down, even for a second.
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我知道，只要稍有松懈，哪怕一秒，我就完了。

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: A bigger male started to get real close. I shoved at him with my hand...
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 一只更大的雄性越凑越近。我伸手推他……

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: ...but with a low, rumbling growl, he unsheathed right in front of me.
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……可他喉间低低一吼，就在我面前把鸡巴伸出了肉鞘。

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: Jeez, his dick was twice the size of mine! I wasn't brave enough to shove him again.
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 天哪，他的鸡巴比我的大一倍！我可不敢再推他了。

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: After that, they knew I wasn't a threat. Fearlessly they rubbed against me,
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那之后，他们知道我没威胁，便大胆地往我身上蹭，

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: marking me with their strange scent. They mouthed my nape, pawed my ass...
vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 用怪异气味标记我。他们含咬我的后颈，揉捏我的屁股……

vsn/m_AgentM01/script.vsn.source: text: I'll probably never forget that first cold nose under my tail, the ticklish

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: Yeah, none of this was appropriately "Top" in any way!
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没错，这哪有半点「上位」该有的样子！

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: I was too slow on my feet to get away from the Wyverns I was surrounded by
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我的腿脚太慢，逃不出那群包围我的双足飞龙，

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: and the rowdy boys seemed to recognize that I was covered in the smell of sex
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那些躁动的家伙似乎闻出了我满身的性爱气味

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: just not the VERY IMPORTANT specifics of the sex!
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 就是没搞懂那场性爱里至关重要的细节！

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: Tried to break the news to the boys that I wasn't really, like, a bottom
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我试着告诉他们，我其实不是受，

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: but the bastards seemed much more interested in breaking in my ass instead!
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可那些混蛋显然更想把我的后穴干开！

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: Like, sure, I went through some anal safety training back at the academy
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 好吧，我在学院确实受过一些肛交安全训练

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: that was just to take care of prerequisites though! I wasn't into it!
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可那只是为了完成必修训练！我才不好这一口！

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: I wasn't even into it when the Wyverns took turns on me, hour after hour!
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 双足飞龙轮流干了我好几个小时，我可一点没享受！

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: Yeah, sure, you can review this data log and all that
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 是啦，你确实可以翻这份数据记录什么的

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: and yeah, sure, you can see me cumming hands free while in a Wyvern sandwich
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 对，没错，你能看见我被双足飞龙夹着，不用手就射了，

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: but none of that changes the fact that it wasn't something I signed up for!
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可那也改变不了，这根本不是我报名要干的事！

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: ...you're wondering why I didn't escape from the nests as soon as I could
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……你想问，我为什么没尽早从巢穴逃走

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: despite not being chained up or anything like that?
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 明明没被锁链拴住，也没受什么束缚？

vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.source: text: ...so anyways, maybe I'll sign up for non-top agent sorties when I get back...
vsn/m_AgentM03/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……总之，回去后也许该报名不当上位特工的外勤了……

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: Ahh! Sorry lad! I don't know what came over me there!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 啊！抱歉，小伙子！我也不知道刚才怎么鬼迷心窍了！

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: ...Or what came over my tazer, for that matter...
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……或者该问，我的电击枪又是怎么了……

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: ...wait no that was me...
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……等等，不对，那是我……

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: Let's start at the beginning, shall we?
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 咱们从头说起，好吗？

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02B
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02B

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: A shame you had to see me like that, but it's not really my fault.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可惜让你看见我那副样子，可这真不是我的错。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: It all began when I stumbled upon a group of Dwarves in the midst of scouting.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 一切都始于侦察时，我偶遇了一群矮人。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: I was too engrossed in mapping out this large mine area that they call Ayskammr
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我太专心绘制那片叫艾斯卡姆的大矿区地图了

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: so I was caught off guard as the burly boys started to tear at my uniform!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以壮汉们突然撕扯我的制服，让我措手不及！

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02C
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02C

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: I probably don't have to explain it, but I of course held back while fighting
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这大概不用解释，打斗时我当然手下留情了

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: being as prodigiously buff as I am, I worried about hurting the poor Dwarves
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我壮得如此惊人，当然担心伤着那些可怜的矮人

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: they clearly had taken a passing interest in muscular development, but alas
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们显然对练肌肉也只是稍有兴趣，但可惜

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: there was just no comparison between us.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们跟我根本没法比。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: While holding back, one of the boys quite rudely grabbed my tail. Scandalous!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我正手下留情，一个家伙却无礼地抓住我的尾巴。太不像话！

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02D
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02D

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: Such rudeness was no way to repay the kindness that I showed them. Nosirree.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我好心待他们，他们却这么无礼，哪有这种道理！

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: It was enough to make a man consider teaching the brash lad a /proper/ lesson.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 真让人想给那冒失小子一个/像样/的教训。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: As I considered a fitting punishment, the Dwarf seemed inclined to escalate things
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我正琢磨该怎么惩罚，那矮人似乎还想得寸进尺

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: and it was at that point that I decided to take things seriously.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 也就是那时，我决定认真起来。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02E
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02E

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: Treating me like I was a common boylass for them to enjoy, such nerve.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 竟把我当成随便给他们玩弄的男婊子，真是放肆。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: In a burst of fairness I tried to warn the crudes that they were about to be
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 出于公平，我还好心警告那群粗人，接下来他们就要

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: on the receiving end of my full power.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 承受我使出全力的一击。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: The poor kids didn't know what they were bringing on themselves...
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那帮可怜的小子，根本不知自己惹上了什么……

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02F
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02F

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: Luckily for the brats, an interloper came along before I showed them whatfor!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 算那帮崽子走运，我正要教训他们，就来了个搅局的！

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: I unclenched my... fist... and breathed a sigh of relief.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我松开紧握的……拳头……长舒了一口气。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: A gentleman such as I hates to resort to violence, as should be apparent.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 像我这样的绅士，显然最不愿诉诸暴力。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02G
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02G

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: It was then that the youngsters decided to hightail out of the vicinity
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这时，那帮小子决定夹着尾巴逃离此地

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: being overcome with coward- ice once they realized what they were up against.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 看清自己面对的是什么后，他们都吓破了胆。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: I gave them a word or two of advice while they retreated, for good measure.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们撤退时，我还好心补了几句忠告。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): Black
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): Black

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: Now this is where things start to get a bit hazy. Uncharacteristically so...
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 从这儿起，记忆就有点模糊了。这可不像我平时的记性……

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: I turned to introduce myself to the fella that had chanced upon the scene
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我转身向那个碰巧路过的家伙自我介绍，

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: and then... I can't recall much...
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 然后……我就记不太清了……

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: ...some mesmerizing light... ...warm and... grabby...?
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……某种迷人的光……暖暖的……还会乱摸……？

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02H
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02H

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: Yes that's right, I was just about to warn the fella to leave the fighting to me
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 对，没错，我正要叫那家伙把战斗交给我

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: but I think I was in the clutches of... some ghostly hands?
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可我记得自己好像被……几只幽灵手抓住了？

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: No, that can't be right. I think there was some weapon that he may have aimed at me
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不，不可能。我想他或许拿某种武器对准了我

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: not that there's no weapon I can't handle, of course.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 当然，也不是说有什么武器是我应付不了的。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02I
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02I

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: Right, of course, that must have been it. The cad sudd- enly engaged in shenanigans
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 对，没错，肯定是这样。那无赖突、突然耍起了花招

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: and I was forced to beat him off repeatedly!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 逼得我一遍遍把他打退！

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: If memory serves me correct, I was doing such a good job at defending myself
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没记错的话，我的自卫实在太出色，

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: that his lordship considered me to be a very good boy. A proud hour!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 连那位大人都夸我是个乖孩子。真是光荣时刻！

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02J
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02J

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: Hold on, no... what? Why would I be a good boy...
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 等等，不……什么？我怎么会是乖孩子……

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: why would those words fill me with glee, even now...
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 为什么就算现在，听到这话还是会满心欢喜……

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: Disregard whatever nonsense was recorded then, clearly it's unreliable.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那时候录下的胡话别当真，显然不可靠。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02K
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): AreaAMale02K

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: The important thing is that when you found me, I had been left alone in this cell
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 重点是，你找到我时，我已被独自丢在这间牢房里，

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: with naught to entertain myself with but my de-energized tazer
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 除了那把没电的电击枪，什么消遣也没有

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: and a lingering desire to be called a good boy once more.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 还有那挥不去的渴望，想再被夸一句乖孩子。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): Black
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): Black

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: Thankfully, a good bop on the snout returned me to my rightful state of mind!
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 幸好鼻头挨了一记，我就彻底清醒了！

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: If you find any map data disks out in these mines, there's no need to thank me.
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 要在矿井里找到地图数据盘，不用谢我。

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: It's all in a day's work for this...
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 对我这个……来说，都只是日常工作……

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: good...
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 乖……

vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.source: text: boy...?
vsn/m_AgentM04/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 孩子……？
