vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 勇敢的英雄啊，感谢你救出我，证明了你的勇气。

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Now, place your hands upon mine.
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放在我的手上。

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 将心神转向内在，见证塑造这片土地的往事……

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): We, the Fenfen, have lived for eons on this planet that you know as "Tutone".
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们Fenfen，在你们称作“图托恩”的星球上已生活了无数岁月。

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Having eschewed the sort of technological advances that your culture thrives on
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 摒弃了你们的文化赖以繁荣的那类技术进步之后，

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): we have lived simple, satisfying lives in harmony with the planet itself.
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们与星球本身和谐共处，过着简单而满足的生活。

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Quiet and modest are the best ways to describe us Fenfen.
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 安静谦逊，最适合形容我们Fenfen。

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): All major quarrels were sorted out by a council of the wisest ESPers we had.
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 所有重大争端，都由我们最睿智的超能力者组成的议会裁决。

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): With our highly attuned senses and powers, we were able to find solutions that
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 凭借敏锐的感官与力量，我们总能找到办法，

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): benefitted all of society at once.
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 能让整个社会一同受益。

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): However, even with our attunement...
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 然而，即便有着这份感应力……

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...we were not able to sense that amongst us ESPers lay one whose ambitions
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……我们竟未察觉，超能力者之中藏着一人，其野心

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): would throw the very planet itself into chaos...
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 会令整颗星球陷入混乱……

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Gifted beyond her years, with an uncanny ability to find solutions others missed
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 天赋远超其年纪，又有着总能找到他人所遗漏之解法的非凡本事，

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): the ESPer Traeh seemed like a fine addition to the council.
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 超能力者特蕾，看上去是议会的一位出色新成员。

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): She was readily granted access to the stores of power that we Fenfen kept.
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 她很轻易便获准接触我们Fenfen所封存的力量贮藏。

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Power... that she then proceeded to corrupt.
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 力量……而她随即着手将其腐化。

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Absorbing ancient caches of ESPer power that were left by previous generations
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 吸收了前代遗留下来的古老超能力者力量贮藏之后，

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Traeh was left deeply disfigured, down to her very core.
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 特蕾从外貌到内心，都已扭曲得面目全非。

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Maybe if we, the remaining elder ESPers of the council, reacted faster
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 也许我们议会中剩下的超能力者长老若能更快应对

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): then we could've prevented the calamity that was about to befall our people.
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 或许就能阻止那场即将降临族人的浩劫。

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Alas, we did not, and that will forever be our greatest failing...
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 可惜我们没有，这永远是我们最大的过失……

vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Free my brothers and sisters and restore peace to the land!
vsn/m_AgentMZ1/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 解救我的兄弟姐妹，让这片土地重归安宁！

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 勇敢的英雄啊，感谢你救出我，证明了你的勇气。

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Now, place your hands upon mine.
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放在我的手上。

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 将心神转向内在，见证塑造这片土地的往事……

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): When Traeh turned her aggressions to us remaining members of the ESPer council
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 当特蕾把矛头转向我们超能力者议会的其余成员时，

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): it was unlike anything that we had ever encountered.
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 那是我们从未遭遇过的可怕局面。

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): We were a peaceful, though perhaps squabbly, folk!
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们是个爱好和平的民族，顶多有些爱拌嘴！

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Violence and ESPer powered aggression were unknown to us!
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 暴力，以及超能力者力量驱动的攻击，我们闻所未闻！

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Traeh was not alone in her new ambitions, however.
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 然而，怀有这番新野心的并非只有特蕾。

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Formerly placable creatures began to rise up as though answering her call.
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 原本温顺的生物也纷纷崛起，仿佛在回应她的召唤。

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Their combined powers were frightening...
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 他们联合起来的力量，令人胆寒……

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...and it seemed as if all hope was lost!
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……而一切希望仿佛就此落空！

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): No amount of reason nor pleading would stop the newly emboldened creatures
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 无论说理还是哀求，都拦不住那些气焰日盛的生物

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): and even our cries for mercy went unanswered.
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 连我们求饶的呼声也得不到半点回应。

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Those very cries seemed to only fuel Traeh's power and ambition even more.
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 那些哀嚎，似乎反而助长了特蕾的力量与野心。

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): With each new section of Tutone conquered she would set her eyes on another
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 每征服图托恩一片土地，她便盯上下一片，

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): until it seemed that the very planet itself would bend to her will.
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 直到仿佛连星球本身都要屈从于她的意志。

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Any Fenfen that couldn't hide in the shadows of what we once called home
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 任何无法躲进我们曾称之为家的阴影之下的Fenfen

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): became enslaved to do the bidding of the new conquerors.
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 全沦为奴隶，听从新征服者的差遣。

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): This was no longer a quiet and modest life for us...
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们的生活，再也谈不上安静谦逊了……

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Yes, our very home seemed destined to fall under the cruel fist of Traeh.
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 没错，我们的家园仿佛注定落入特蕾的残暴铁拳。

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): It was a level of cruelty that was unknown in the long history of us Fenfen
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 那种残暴，在我们Fenfen漫长的历史中闻所未闻

vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): and it seemed as if all hope were lost...
vsn/m_AgentMZ2/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 而一切希望仿佛都已不复存在……

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 勇敢的英雄啊，感谢你救出我，证明了你的勇气。

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Now, place your hands upon mine.
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放在我的手上。

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 将心神转向内在，见证塑造这片土地的往事……

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): As dark forces descended on all Fenfen, young and old alike,
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 当黑暗势力降临到全体Fenfen——无论老幼——头上时，

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): it truly did seem like all hope was lost.
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 那时，仿佛一切希望都已破灭。

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Powerful though the ESPers of our people may have been, violence was unknown to us.
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们族中的超能力者纵然或许强大，暴力对我们却全然陌生。

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Only when pushed to the end of options, when even surrender seemed impossible
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 直到被逼得走投无路，甚至连投降都不可能时，

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): did the first of us strike out...
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们中才终于有人率先反击……

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Psychic abilities once turned only towards a common good
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 曾经只用于共同福祉的心灵能力，

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): would now be turned against those who would try to subjugate us Fenfen!
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 如今要用来反抗那些妄图奴役我们Fenfen的敌人！

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): An arsenal of ESPer abilities became harnessed as weapons of war.
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 超能力者的能力武库被征用为战争的武器。

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Explosive psychic projectiles blasted away foes.
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 爆裂的灵能弹将敌人轰飞。

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Punishing waves of telekinetic force prevented advancement of armies.
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 强劲的念动力波阻住了大军的推进。

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Some even went so far as to transform their very bodies into tools for combat.
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 有些人甚至把自己的身体变成了战斗兵器。

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Ancient beings heard the cries of mental anguish that rang throughout the planet
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 古老的存在们听见了回荡于整颗星球的精神痛呼，

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Some, like the noble Elves, took up ancient weapons in order to aid us Fenfen...
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 有些如高贵的精灵，拿起古老兵器援助我们Fenfen……

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...while other ancient beings, from deep within the bowels of the planet
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……而其他古老的存在，则从这颗星球最深的地底，

vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): awoke with a desire for vengeance and domination of their own...
vsn/m_AgentMZ3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 带着属于它们自己的复仇与征服欲望苏醒了……

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 勇敢的英雄啊，感谢你救出我，证明了你的勇气。

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Now, place your hands upon mine.
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放在我的手上。

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 将心神转向内在，见证塑造这片土地的往事……

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): The great war waged for years between the evil forces of Traeh
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 这场大战持续多年，交战双方是特蕾的邪恶势力

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): and the formerly peaceful Fenfen that inhabited this land.
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 和这片土地上原本爱好和平的Fenfen。

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): It seemed to all that this war might go on forever, with no decisive victories.
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 所有人都觉得，这场战争也许永无休止，谁也无法彻底取胜。

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Without a vital member of the Fenfen council representing a vital force
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 议会失去了一位代表重要力量的 Fenfen 核心成员，

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): the remaining councilors were hamstrung.
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 余下的议员便处处受制。

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): The psychic bonds between the members still held, requiring constant vigilance
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 成员之间的灵能联结依然维系着，只是需要时刻保持警觉，

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): to keep dark forces from consuming more ESPers.
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 以免黑暗力量吞噬更多超能力者。

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...but then, one day, an opportunity arose...
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……但有一天，机会终于来了……

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): A moment of psychic weakness left Traeh disarmed and distracted for but a moment
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 心灵上的一时虚弱，让特蕾卸下防备、分了神，哪怕只有一瞬，

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): and in that moment the remaining members of the council struck!
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 就在那一刻，其余议员出手了！

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Unable to overcome the psychic disturbance and deal a final blow,
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 无法克服这股灵能扰动、给出致命一击，

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): the councilors instead froze Traeh in a crystal prison.
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 议员们转而将特蕾封冻在一座水晶囚牢之中。

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): With no fierce leader to guide them, the oppor- tunistic hordes broke apart
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 没有了凶悍首领的指引，那群见风转舵的乌合之众土崩瓦解，

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): fleeing from the powers of the Fenfen council.
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 仓皇逃离Fenfen议会的力量。

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): This is not to say that it was a triumphant moment for the Fenfen...
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 这并不是说，对Fenfen而言这是一个凯旋的时刻……

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Indeed, heavy prices were paid on both sides of the conflict.
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 确实，冲突双方都付出了惨重代价。

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): The planet you landed on is no longer the peaceful home of the Fenfen
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 你降落的星球，已不再是Fenfen的和平家园，

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): but merely a chaotic shadow of its former self.
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 而只是往日模样的一个混沌残影。

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Many Fenfen as of yet are held captive by remnants of the would-be conquerors
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 至今，仍有许多Fenfen被那些妄图征服我们的残党囚禁

vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): awaiting the day that a hero will free them...
vsn/m_AgentMZ4/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 等待着英雄前来解救的那一天……

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 勇敢的英雄啊，感谢你救出我，证明了你的勇气。

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Now, place your hands upon mine.
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放在我的手上。

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 将心神转向内在，见证塑造这片土地的往事……

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): As us Fenfen strove to rebuild our home and drive out the remnants of evil
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 当我们Fenfen努力重建家园、驱逐邪恶的残余势力时，

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): some of us looked up into the sky and saw a shooting star coming down.
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 我们当中有人仰望天空，看见一颗流星正向下坠落。

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Perhaps Fate had sent us a hero, with which we could regain our peace?
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 或许是命运为我们送来了一位英雄，让我们能借助这位英雄重获安宁？

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Or perhaps Fate had a more sinister joke to play on us suffering Fenfen
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 又或许，命运还想对饱受苦难的我们Fenfen开一个更加阴险的玩笑，

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): for this visitor from the stars did not land on our planet proper...
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 因为这位来自群星的访客并没有降落在我们的星球本身……

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...instead, they landed on the satellite rock that held Traeh's prison!
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……而是降落在了那颗设有特蕾监牢的岩石卫星上！

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): As if destined for only a single purpose, the interstellar interloper
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 仿佛注定只有一个目的，那位星际闯入者

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): made their way to the very core of Traeh's prison.
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 一路来到了特蕾监牢的最深处。

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Had her psychic tendrils found their way into a poor fool's mind?
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 难道她的灵能触须已经伸进了某个可怜傻瓜的脑海？

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): There is no way to know if it was dark ESPer power at work or merely curiosity
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 究竟是黑暗的超能力者力量在作祟，还是仅仅出于好奇，已经无从知晓，

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): but this traveler made contact with the crystal prison that held Traeh...
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 但这位旅人触碰了囚禁特蕾的水晶监牢……

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...and so they became undone, unable to resist the dark ESPer forces.
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……就这样，这位旅人无力抵抗黑暗的超能力者力量，最终沦陷了。

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Power and pain coursed through the poor explorer
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 力量与痛苦流遍了这位可怜的探险者全身，

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): until their mind was no longer their own.
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 直到心智再也不属于自己。

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): No, from that moment forth they answered to a darker power...
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 不，从那一刻起，这位旅人听命于一股更黑暗的力量……

vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): They did as Traeh commanded!
vsn/m_AgentMZ5/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 特蕾吩咐什么，其便做什么！

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 勇敢的英雄啊，感谢你救出我，证明了你的勇气。

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Now, place your hands upon mine.
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放在我的手上。

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 将心神转向内在，见证塑造这片土地的往事……

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Having touched the prison of Traeh, the interloper was no longer themself.
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 触碰特蕾的牢笼后，闯入者便不再是原来的自己。

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Enough dark psychic power had passed in that one moment of contact
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 就在接触的那一刻，已有足够多的黑暗灵能传递了过去，

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): that Traeh had a willing minion to send out into the wild.
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 特蕾也就有了一个甘愿效命的爪牙，可被差往荒野。

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): One by one, this twisted agent rounded up the remaining council members
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 这名扭曲的特工，把余下的议员逐一抓走，

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ensuring that the powers that kept Traeh imprisoned weakened more each day.
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 以此确保囚禁特蕾的力量一天天地衰弱下去。

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Even if the wise council members were intent on psychically detaining Traeh
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 即便睿智的议会成员决意以心灵之力拘禁特蕾，

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): after being subjugated to experiment after dark experiment...
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 可在遭受一场又一场黑暗实验之后……

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): ...not even the wisest of Fenfen minds could wage battles on that many fronts.
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): ……即便是Fenfen中最智慧的头脑，也无法在如此众多的战线上同时作战。

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Without the powers of the Fenfen council to hold Traeh prisoner
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 没了Fenfen议会的力量囚禁特蕾

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): it's only a matter of time before she's able to break free and wage war once more.
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 她挣脱束缚、再度掀起战争，只是时间问题。

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): And this time, there will be no resistance against her evil power.
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 而这一次，再没人能抵挡她的邪恶力量。

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): The only thing that keeps this evil Queen from conquering all of Tutone
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 唯一让这邪恶女王尚未征服整个图托恩的，

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): is her desire to gain enough strength to transfer into a new host body.
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 只是她想先积攒足够的力量，转移到新的宿主身体里。

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Perhaps, then, it is another twist of Fate that sent you to this planet
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 那么，或许又是命运的转折，将你送来这颗星球，

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): and had you arrive so near to where all this calamitous action took place.
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 并且让你来到距离这场灾难发生之地如此之近的地方。

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Will you be an even more powerful host for Traeh, Queen of Darkness?
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 你会成为黑暗女王特蕾更强大的宿主吗？

vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.source: lang(Fox): Or will you be the saviour of the Fenfen, a beacon of courage and hope...?
vsn/m_AgentMZ6/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(Fox): 还是说，你会成为Fenfen的救星，勇气与希望的明灯……？

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Wow, I wasn't expecting a rowdy fella like you around here!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哇，没想到这里有你这么闹腾的家伙！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Didn't mean to be so rough with you, but you know how it is!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不是故意下手这么重的，可你也懂嘛！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Gotta get physical one way or another to calm down a big beast like yourself!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 要让你这头大野兽冷静，总得有点肢体接触！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: On the bright side, looks like some of my gear ended up in here too.
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 往好处想，我的一些装备好像也落在这儿了。

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: And here it is, my trusty sideblade.
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 找到了，我那可靠的佩刃。

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Not a particularly strong Lighttazer, but...
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这把光电击枪威力不算大，不过……

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: ...it's definitely a privilege to carry such an elegant weapon as this.
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……能带着这么精致的武器，真是荣幸。

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: It's my duty as a Cosmobreeder to take care of it!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 身为宇宙育种者，保养它是我的职责！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Ever since I was a pup, I had always wanted to be a Cosmobreeder.
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 从小狗崽时起，我就一直想当宇宙育种者。

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: ...even if I didn't really know what the "breeding" part meant at the time!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……虽然那时，我还不懂“育种”是什么意思！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: All I knew was that a life filled with excitement and adventure
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我只知道，充满刺激与冒险的生活

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: is what I was born to do!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 就是我生来该过的日子！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: After working my tail off for all those years, here I am now.
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 拼死拼活努力了那么多年，如今我总算站到了这里。

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: The 3P's 21 year old prodigy, on my very first mission!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 3P 组织二十一岁的天才，第一次出任务！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Now it's time to put that training to use!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 该让训练成果派上用场了！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: I hope you're as excited as I am, big guy!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 大块头，希望你也跟我一样兴奋！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: At least PART of you seems excited, hehe...
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 至少你身上某个部位挺兴奋嘛，嘿嘿……

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Kinda nubbly, but you've got a nice taper too.

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Got theshe fun little nubsh along the one shide of ya, too.

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Oh well, at leasht I get to get familiar with your bitsh while you shnooze
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 算啦，趁你打盹，至少我能熟悉熟悉你的宝贝，

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: shince all your important partsh are nice and active still!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 反正你那些要紧的部位，还活蹦乱跳着呢！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: If I didn't know better, I'd shay they were even enjoying thish all...
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 要不是知道内情，我都要说它们挺享受了……

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: ...your nubsh are getting shlightly harder, even if your shaft ishn't...

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: ...it makesh me want to shuck on it more!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……害得我更想继续吸吮它！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Mmmh, WAY better than jusht ushing a toy.
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 嗯唔，比只用玩具舒服多啦。

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: I hope all you fellash on thish planet are thish good to play with.
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 但愿你们这星球上的伙计，都这么好玩。

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: that the real thingsh were thish much fun!

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Or maybe I'm alsho doing thingsh to you in your dreamsh!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 说不定你梦里也是我在玩弄你呢！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Wouldn't shurprishe me, you sheemed dishtracted by my assh in the fight.
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 也不奇怪啦，打架时你好像就光顾着看我屁、屁股了。

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Don't shyou worry though, I'll be shure to give you a tashte of tail too.

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Almosht like itsh never ending, wow...!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 简直好像射不完一样，哇……！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Even after all that, you're still rearing to go?
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 都这样了，你还想再来？

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Must be because of how good I am! I'm not just an ANAL prodigy, you know!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 肯定是我技术太好！我可不只是肛交天才！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Just makes you want to keep going forever, amirite?
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 爽得让你想一直干下去，对吧？

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: Sleepy head has finally woken up after some sleepy head!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 享受过睡梦中的口交，瞌睡鬼终于醒啦！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: You ready to grab me by the hips and make me your bi-

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: I'm not gonna hurt ya, that was just the warm-up! Come back here!!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 又不会弄伤你，那才只是热身！给我回来！！

vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.source: text: I still need to properly gather data before... oh darn it!
vsn/m_ClassicBigbold/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我还得先好好收集数据才……哎，真是的！

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Could probably have taken you out in one smack if they gave me a better tazer
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 要是给我把好点的电击枪，我大概一击就能放倒你

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: instead of this weak little trainee gear.
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 而不是这套弱得可怜的实习装备。

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: They were worried that I might hurt myself or get my gear stolen. Yeah right!
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们怕我伤到自己，或被抢走装备。真会瞎操心！

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: As if I haven't already spent years studying up on all the safety protocols
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 说得好像我没花好几年钻研那些安全规程似的

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: nevermind all the various ways to safely study all sorts of creatures.
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 更别说安全研究各种生物的种种方法了。

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: But nope, even a prodigy like me has to start off with a weakened lighttazer.
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可偏不行，连我这样的天才也得先用弱化版光电击枪。

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: You'd think that spending hour after hour in the training lab until I was
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 按理说，我在训练室一练就是好几个小时，直到，

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: plapping my ass down as good as any veteran agent could would convince them!
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 练到屁股骑得啪嗒响、不输老特工，总该让他们服气吧！

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: I know how to handle all sorts of dangerous stuff! Foes or gear or anything!
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 各种危险我都懂怎么应付！敌人也好，装备也好，什么都行！

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: ...and now it's time to show them that I wasn't bluffing.
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……现在该让他们知道，我可没虚张声势。

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: ...wow though, you really are big, aren't ya? Probably at least a class 3...
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……哇，不过你真够大的，是吧？至少得有三级……

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: W-well, I'm sure I don't need a warm up for something this e-easy! Let's go!

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Lubrication: Adequate. Shaft: Semi-prehensile. Nubs: Malleable and mobile.

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: A little bit of nerves but that's to be expected, r-right?

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你、你快忍不住了吧？嘿、嘿嘿，我就知道。

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: How do ya like THIS now? Cosmobreeder Yiffai Tail Ride Mach 3, coming up!
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这招如何？宇宙育种者伊法伊，尾骑三马赫，来了！

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Wait until I rev up to the full spee-
text: Oh gosh, did you just... the warmth...!
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 天哪，你刚刚是不是……好暖……！

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Something about all that data gathering after a good hard fight
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 痛痛快快打上一架后，再采集这些数据

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: really makes it all the more enjoyable!
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 真的让整个过程更享受了！

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: It's enough to make a guy think of...
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这都让人忍不住想……

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: I was just joking! There's no reason to run away like that!
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我开玩笑的！用不着就这么逃跑吧！

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: O-oh, your poor head... And that poor door...!
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 噢、噢，你可怜的脑袋……还有那扇可怜的门……！

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: You know, I was hoping to leave back the way I came...
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我本来还想从原路回去呢……

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: But now I just gotta hope that the ceiling doesn't...
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 现在只能盼着天花板别……

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: First my gear stolen, and now a ceiling collapsing on top of me?
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 先是装备被偷，现在连天花板都塌下来砸我？

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: Can't I get ANY lucky breaks down here???
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 在这鬼地方，我就不能走一回运吗？？？

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: ...wait a sec, what's that falling from up there...?
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……等下，上头掉下来的是什么……？

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: No way... it can't be!
text: Oh, awesome! Now THIS is a lucky break!
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 噢，太棒了！这下真走运了！

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: It's not every day that a hyper bracer falls into your lap!
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 超能护腕可不是天天都能捡到的！

vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.source: text: With this I'll be able to hyper slide my way out of here in a jiffy!
vsn/m_ClassicBigboldV2/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 有了它，我就能靠超能滑行一溜烟冲出去了！

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: Some of you little folks have some proper fight in you... Heh!
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你们这帮小个子里，还真有几个能打的……嘿！

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: I'd almost thought that the lot of you were merely an annoyance
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我还差点以为，你们这群家伙只会惹人烦

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: but here's one that actually manged to hit me. Heh!
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没想到还真有一个打中我了。呵！

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: What's next, one of you coming along and knocking me down to-
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 接下来呢，你们还想来一个把我也撞——

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: Come on, I beat you fair and square! Stop trying to act cool.
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 得了，我可是堂堂正正打赢你的！别装酷了。

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: You know I'm a better fighter, and I accept your defeat.
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你知道我身手更强，我也接受你的认输。

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: No more harm will come to you so long as you tell me whe-
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不会再伤你，只要告诉我在—

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: W-what?? How did you get behind me so fast???
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 什、什么？？你怎么一下就到我背后了？？？

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: Harm? My little yellow furred companion? You wish to tell me of harm?
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 伤害？黄毛小朋友，你要跟我谈伤害？

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: Perhaps you'd like a lesson in just such a topic as "harm"
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 也许你想亲自上一堂关于“伤害”的课

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: and then you can recite it to me, no?
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 然后再背给我听，如何？

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: Y-yeah... I can... I can tell you a lot about harm... now.... oow....
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 是、是啊……现在……伤害这事，我懂得可多了……嗷……

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: ...j-just lemme get my breath back...
text: Here, spunky yellow boy. Take your leave of my domain.
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 好吧，有股冲劲的黄毛小子，离开我的领地吧。

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: And while you're at it, take this garbage that a fellow small fighter left
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 顺便，把另一个小个子战士留下的垃圾带走

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: after I had given him an even rougher lesson than yours.
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我当时给他的教训，可比给你的还要狠。

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: With shoes in hand, Yiffai scrambles out as the Redbull drops deeper into the mines
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 伊法伊拿着靴子爬出去，红牛则深入矿井

vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.source: text: his glowing red mane fading eerily into the dark...
vsn/m_ClassicBossRedbull/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他泛着红光的鬃毛诡异地隐入黑暗……

vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: Woah, you really took a beating, lady!
vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哇，你可真是挨了好一顿揍啊，女士！

vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: But you look just as fresh as you did when I first entered here...
vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可你看起来还是跟我刚进来时一样精神……

vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: You're really one of those immortal elves, ain't ya?
vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你真的是那些不朽精灵中的一员，对吧？

vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: Correct, my young sir. I am Enelye, the Immortal High Lady of the Tutone Elves.
vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没错，年轻的先生。我是恩内莉，图托恩精灵的不朽至高女领主。

vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: I must commend your most respectable performance in the art of combat
vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你在战斗技艺上的表现令人肃然起敬，我必须予以赞扬，

vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: it was a highly enjoyable act to watch, even for one as old as I.
vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 即便对我这样年长的人而言，观赏这场表演也十分愉快。

vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: It was so enjoyable, that I believe you are due for a reward.
vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 实在是太令人愉快了，我想你理应得到一份奖励。

vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: So please, sit back and relax while I...
vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以，请坐好，放松下来，让我……

vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: H-hey! Come on lady! You gotta be making some mistake!
vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 喂、喂！拜托，女士！你肯定是弄错什么了！

vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: ...n-no no no! I'm a boy! I don't wear these sorts of... dresses!
vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……不、不不不！我是男孩！我不穿这种……裙子！

vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.source: text: N-not that there's anything wrong with boys in dresses... but... b-but...!
vsn/m_ClassicEnelye/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 倒、倒不是说男孩穿裙子有什么不对……可是……可、可是……！

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: lang(HardFox): Thou hast fought a fair round for such an untrained hand.
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(HardFox): 汝虽未经锤炼，这一战却也打得不差。

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: lang(HardFox): Pray, tell me thine name so that I may honor thee.
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(HardFox): 敢问阁下尊姓大名，好让吾致以敬意。

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: lang(HardFox): ...ahh, but the people of thy land do not speaketh my tongue...
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(HardFox): ……啊，然而汝故土之民，并不通晓吾之言语……

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: W-what? No matter how much I fight... There's just no winning!
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 什、什么？再怎么打……都赢不了！

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: Who are you? W-what are you doing down here?
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你是谁？你、你在下面做什么？

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: lang(HardFox): I need not speaketh your crude tongue in order to understand your crude desire
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(HardFox): 无需说汝那粗鄙之语，吾亦明了汝粗鄙之欲

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: lang(HardFox): So struggle not as I placeth a most useful trinket upon thee.
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: lang(HardFox): 莫要挣扎，且让吾为汝戴上这实用的小饰物。

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: H-hey! What the hell is this? I'm not some darn pet of yours to collar!
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 喂、喂！搞什么鬼？我又不是你家宠物，戴什么项圈！

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: I'll find a way to bring you down, just give me a minute and I'll-
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我会想办法打倒你的，给我一分钟，我就——

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: And thou shall do what, fairest knight?
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那么，俊美的骑士，汝又待如何？

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: Mine powers are ancient and forgotten, and thou are but a pup lost in the dark.
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 吾之力量古老而被世人遗忘，汝不过是迷失黑暗的小犬。

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: Prayeth that I overlook your ill mannered outburst, as the generous host I am.
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 祈求吾这位宽宏的主人，不计较汝方才的无礼罢。

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: Now taketh this necklace so that you may understand others of this land
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 且收下这项链，好让汝听懂此地众人的话语

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: ...and spareth them from your ill manners...eh heh heh heh...
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……也省得旁人再领教汝的无礼……呵呵呵呵……

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: And with a gutteral laugh, the demonic form faded back into the darkest darks
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 伴着喉间一阵低笑，那魔影退回了最深的黑暗

vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.source: text: leaving nought but a scared pup in his wake...
vsn/m_ClassicPigobinV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 只留下一个吓坏了的小狗崽……

vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: Now WHY did you have to go and do that, huh?
vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 现在，你干嘛非得去干那种事，嗯？

vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: One of you sorts went and ransacked all my belongings right after I landed
vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我前脚刚落地，你们这种家伙就后脚把我所有家当翻了个精光

vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: and now you're trying to take me down in one-on-one combat?
vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 如今你却想在一对一单挑里把我打倒？

vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: No chance! I've just about had enough of you little bra-
vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没门！我真是受够了你们这些小混-

vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: It's my Cosmohelm! It got all the way over here somehow!
vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 是我的Cosmohelm！它不知怎么一路跑到这边来了！

vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: This'll be real good to have in case I ever have to go into space or something!
vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 万一哪天我得上太空什么的，这玩意儿可就派上大用场了！

vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: Just need to keep an eye out for the Cosmosuit portion...
vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 只要再留心Cosmosuit那一部分就好...

vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.source: text: ...and I'll be able to have a nice proper airtight outfit! Hoorah!
vsn/m_ClassicSqueakerBoss/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……我就能有一套像样的密封好装备啦！好耶！

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: D-darn it! Come on Yiffany, don't you remember me?
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可、可恶！拜托啊，伊法妮，你不记得我了吗？

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: It's me! Your little brother! Darn it!!!
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 是我啊！你的弟弟！可恶！！！

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: Nnngh... d-don't worry, lil bro, I remember you...
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 唔……别、别担心，弟弟，我记得你……

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: But give me another concussion and I can't say I'll keep on remembering you
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过你要是再把我打出一次脑震荡，我可不敢保证还能记得你

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: so maybe give me a moment, eh?
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以让我缓一会儿，行吗？

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: Let me have at least... 5 seconds to clear my head before you swing...
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你再动手之前，至少给我……5秒钟清醒一下脑子……

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: and then I'll be able to throw you to the ground like old times, alright?
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 然后我就能像以前一样把你摔在地上了，好吧？
text: 你回来了！伊法妮！姐姐！

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: All it took was 3 rounds of repeated blows to your head...
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 只不过是朝你脑袋反复打了3轮……

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: Help me up lil bro, it's not just my head that took the whacking all this time.
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 扶我起来，弟弟，这么一通打下来，挨揍的可不只是我的脑袋。

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: I was under control of... a dark queen.
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我之前被……一位黑暗女王控制着。

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: I feel as if all my energy has been sapped out, now that I'm free from them.
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 如今摆脱了控制，我感觉全身的力气都像被抽干了。

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: Don't think I'm fit for combat anymore, but here: take this.
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我想我现在不适合再战斗了，不过，来，拿着这个。

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: It's the whistle dad gave me when I first started to follow in his footsteps!
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这是我刚开始追随爸爸的脚步时，他给我的哨子！

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: Blow it practically anywhere and I'll be able to pick you up in your ship.
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 几乎不管在哪儿吹响它，我都能开着你的飞船来接你。

vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.source: text: If nothing else, I can be your pilot while you play at hero this time, okay?
vsn/m_ClassicStarkillV3/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 别的不说，这次你逞英雄的时候，我至少还能当你的飞行员，好吗？

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: There we go! You must be related to that lil pupper running around here, huh?
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 搞定！你肯定跟这附近乱跑的小狗崽有亲戚关系吧？

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Doesn't matter if you're two or ten times the size as that little guy,
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不管你是那小家伙的两倍，还是十倍大，

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: there isn't ANY feral that I can't ta-
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 就没有我驯服不了的兽形——

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Ow what?? I thought you were down for the count!
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 嗷，什么？！我以为你已经倒下了！

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: H-hey, wait a sec! Lemme get ready before y-you...
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 喂、喂，等一下！让我准备好，你、你再……

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Ready to go without wasting any time, just like me huh?
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 跟我一样，半点时间都不想浪费，随时能上，是吧？

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: It's almost like you were reading my mind...
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你简直像会读心一样……

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Hey! Watch the claws! You don't have to hold onto me so tight.
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 嘿！小心爪子！不用抓那么紧。

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: I've got a job to do too, so it's not like I'm going anywhere!
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我也有工作要做，又不会跑！

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: HQ needs to know allll the details of what you're doing.
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 总部得知道你行动的每——个细节。

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Details like how you're barely even rutting me so far!
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 比如你到现在都还没怎么干我！

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: You feral canids always start off so small that you can barely poke in
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你们兽形犬族起初总那么小，几乎都插不进去，

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: despite how fast you hump away!
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不管你们抽插得多快！

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Soon enough, your bulbus glandis will engorge and lock you inside me
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 再过一会儿，你的龟头球就会胀大，把你锁在我体内

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: and I'll get to observe your post-coital behaviour. Very important!
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这样我就能观察你交配后的行为了。这很重要！

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Aww, you're not getting embarrassed, are ya? You don't have to slow down!
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哎呀，你该不会害羞了吧？不用慢下来呀！

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Mmmf, guess you won't even even tie me properly after all. Canid types always
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 嗯哼，看来你到底没法好好锁住我。犬族总是

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: stop thrusting once their knotty swells up...
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 肉结一涨大，就停止抽插……

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: W-woah, you're getting pretty large now...
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哇、哇哦，你现在变得好大……

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: You're starting to... nnfgh... rub me in a good way, too...
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你也开始……嗯呃……磨得我很舒服了……

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Did somebody else train you to do this or what?
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你这是跟谁学的，还是怎么着？

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: This isn't b-because of what I said, is it?
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 该不会是因、因为我刚才说的话吧？

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Y-you don't have to try impress me! HQ might get suspicious, even.
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你、你不用费劲给我留好印象！总部说不定还会起疑。

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Falsifying data is a huge no-no for us Cosmobreeders!
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 对我们宇宙育种者来说，伪造数据可是大忌！

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Wait, w-wait wait a s-sec...
text: ...are you getting even larger? Oh my gosh...
text: That... this... no way...! Slow down!
text: Down boy! Down! You're getting too rough with the...
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 趴下，乖狗！趴下！你对我的……太粗暴了……

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: I... I thought your knot was a-already fully out before, b-but...
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我……我以为你的结刚才就、就已经全胀起来了，可、可是……

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: A-at least now you can say that we t-tied, unlike during the fight.
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 至、至少现在算扯平了……还真“结”住了，不像刚才那场架。

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: If we have a rematch and I don't hold back, will you hump me even harder
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 要是再打一场，我不留手，你会操我操得更狠吗，

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: or would I be too much for you, Mister Feral?
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 还是说，野兽先生，你会招架不住我呢？

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [My young friend, if we have a rematch it'll be very unfortunate]
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [年轻的朋友，再比一场可就不妙了。]

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [as a father, I have much experience play fighting with you little pups]
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [身为父亲，我很有陪你们这些小狗崽打闹的经验]

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [and merely needed to ascertain your character.]
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [只不过需要确认一下你的为人。]

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [For now, witness a fraction of what I can do!]
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [现在，先见识一下我力量的冰山一角吧！]

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [That's right, Yiffai. You have indeed become a feral yourself.]
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [没错，伊法伊。你自己也变成野兽了。]

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [A feral much the same size as my son whom you ruffhoused with earlier.]
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [一只兽形犬，大小跟你先前打闹过的我儿子差不多。]

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [The Zener power that flows though me allows me to transform at will]
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [我体内流淌的泽纳之力，能让我随意变形。]

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [and now that you've taken my seed, so too shall you have the power!]
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [如今你接下了我的精种，也将拥有这力量！]

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [Let us put your new form through its paces, shall we?]
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [来试试你这副新身体的能耐，如何？]

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [I believe you wanted a rematch, though I fear you would not enjoy it.]
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [吾记得汝想再战一回，只怕汝不会喜欢。]

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: [...perhaps your rump could appreciate a "rematch" of sorts, however...]
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [……不过，你的屁股或许会喜欢另一种“再战”……]

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: O-okay, I can turn back now... o-ow...
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 好、好了，我能变回来了……疼、疼……

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: Time to continue d-dominating... ow...
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 该继续征、征服了……疼……

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: ...dominating all the creatures down here...
text: You're sure that yellow dog man is the chosen one, papa?
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 爸爸，你确定那个黄毛狗人就是天选之人？

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: That man, Yiffai, mastered one of the Zener powers in record time
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那位伊法伊，以破纪录的速度掌握了一种泽纳之力，

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: so I have no doubt that he will be the one to set this planet free.
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以我毫不怀疑，解放这星球的人就是他。

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: That sounds so cool! He's a real superhero, isn't he dad?
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 听起来太酷了！爸爸，他是真正的超级英雄，对吧？

vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.source: text: I wish I could train with him next time. Can I dad? Can I??
vsn/m_ClassicWerehund/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 真希望下次能跟他训练。可以吗，爸爸？可以吗？？

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Woah there little guy, what's all this running and jumping around about?
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 喔，小家伙，怎么到处跑跑跳跳的？

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: You almost bopped me good a few times there!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 刚才有好几下，差点真让你揍中了！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Gotta learn to control all that energy that you've got built up.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你得学会控制这一身使不完的劲儿。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Trust me, when you're an energetic little dog like you or I, it's basically
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 信我，像你我这样精力旺盛的小狗，这基本就是，

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: like a super power! Not that I look that young or adorable anymore
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 简直像超能力！当然，我如今可没那么幼嫩可爱了

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: now that I'm a 21 year old full grown man.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 毕竟我现在可是二十一岁的成年男人了。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Still got the energy though!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过精力还是那么旺盛！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: I was still just a pup back when I was finishing up the Cosmobreeder program.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我完成宇宙育种者培训时，还嫩得很呢。
text: 当然，这就是天才的烦恼。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Wasn't allowed to do any hands-on training until I hit 18, but when I finally
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 满十八岁才准实操训练，可等我终于

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: got to sign out training tools and log some valuable VR training hours
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 领用训练器材，积攒宝贵的VR训练时数

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: I was in those VR rooms running and jumping off the walls like you just were!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我就在VR室里像你刚才那样，满屋跑跳蹬墙！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: To be honest, my first VR session didn't have much running or jumping...
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 说实话，我头回VR训练没怎么跑跳……

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: It was a simulation of a previous agent's first sortie.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那是模拟某位前辈特工首次出任务的情景。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Makes sense to start with something like that, but a couple of higher ups
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 从这种任务开始练也合理，可有几个上级，

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: seemed to get a kick out of it. Like it was some inside joke or something.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 似乎觉得特别好笑，好像是什么内部笑话。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: I wasn't fazed though! Joke or not, I was gonna give it my all.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可我没被吓住！管它是不是玩笑，我都要全力以赴。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: As soon as I had the VR gear on and logged into the data steady, it was clear
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我一戴好虚拟现实装备、稳定接入数据，就明白了，

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: that this was going to be a test against a textbook example of a Kobold.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这场测试的对手，就是一只教科书式的科博德。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Not a problem for me, I held the VR tazer steady and prepared a counter...
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这难不倒我，我稳稳端起VR电击枪，准备反击……

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: ...only to be completely disarmed somehow?
text: I...I'm sure it's because I wasn't allowed to deviate from the data log
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我……肯定是因为不准偏离数据记录的流程

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: that's the only way to explain how I got caught by some lowly Space Pirate...
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 只有这样，才说得通我怎么会被低等的太空海盗逮住……

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Those were my thoughts as the Kobold got me against a wall and went under my tail!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 科博德把我抵在墙上、钻到我尾巴底下时，我就是这么想的！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: He was waaaay rougher than any of the automatic training tools were
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他比所有自动训练器具都粗暴得多

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: which explains why I had to use those for a month before I could sign up for VR.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 难怪我得先用那些器材一个月，才能报名VR。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: The various shocks and vibrations administered by the VR gear really made it
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: VR装备的各种电击和震动，真让我

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: feel like I was being pounded against a wall.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 感觉自己真被抵在墙上猛干。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Thankfully, even something this vigorous wasn't enough to knock off my goggles
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 幸好，折腾得这么猛，也没把我的目镜震掉，

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: so I stayed within the VR mission, prepared to see it through to the end.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以我留在虚拟任务里，准备坚持到最后。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: With the RealFeel hardware strapped against my hips, I could even appreciate
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 把实感设备绑在胯上，我甚至能体会

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: what it felt like to take a real Kobold up the tail.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 被真正的科博德插进后穴是什么滋味。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: I remember hearing from some older agents like my sis that this kind of tech
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 记得像我姐那样的老资历特工说过，这种技术

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: wasn't even a thing until a couple years ago.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 直到几年前才出现。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Kinda hard for me to imagine how exciting virgin missions must've been
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 真难想象，初次出任务曾有多刺激

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: before us agents had access to all these top-of-the-line simulation tools...
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 在特工还用不上这些顶尖模拟设备的年代……

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Especially when you know that these large dicked Kobold space pirates
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 尤其想到这些胯下巨硕的科博德太空海盗，

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: have spread to all corners of the galaxy, lurking around every corner.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 已经遍布银河，潜伏在每一个角落。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Don't think I could've handled that Bigbold like such a pro earlier
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 先前我可没法那么老练地搞定那只大壮兽

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: if that had been the first taste of data collection that I ever got.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 如果那是我头一回尝到采集数据的滋味的话。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Even the Kobold in my first VR mission was basically a breeding machine.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 连我首次VR任务里的科博德，都简直是台配种机器。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: All I could do was brace myself against the wall as he sped up his rutting!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他越干越快，我只能撑着墙壁硬挺！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Sometimes I wonder what that virtual mission would've gone like if I fought back
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 有时我会想，那次虚拟任务里要是我反抗了，会怎样

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: ...I mean, if I COULD have fought back!!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……我是说，假如我当时能反抗的话！！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: It's not like I found myself getting lost in the feeling of being bred like a toy.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 才不是我沉迷于被当玩具操着配种的感觉呢。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: N-nope, not me. I'm not the type to get caught up in such s-stupid things!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不、不是我。我才不会沉迷这种蠢、蠢事！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: It's just the way VR stuff works, you know. Gotta follow along with them!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: VR本来就是这么回事，得跟着演嘛！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: If the data said "keep your tail raised and be bitched against a wall"
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 如果数据显示“翘好尾巴，贴墙当母狗挨操”

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: then that's what I had to do!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那我就只好照做啦！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: I definitely wasn't just dickstracted by how amazing it felt to be used.

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Kobold dick twitch and... a-and...
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 科博德的鸡巴抽动……还、还有……

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: O-oooh yeaahhh... Just thinking about the way that virtual Kobo was throbbing
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 噢、噢对啊……光想到那虚拟科博一跳一跳的样子

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: shooting his virtual cummies inside of me while he held me still...

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: I-I mean, it didn't FEEL virtual! Not while hooked up with all that gear.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我、我是说，那感觉根本不像虚拟的！接上那些装备后就更不像了。

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: All the sensations of being bred by a real Kobold stud were coming through, and
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 被真正的科博德猛男干的种种感觉，全传过来了，而且，

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: there were even special electrical impulses that forced some arousal in me!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 甚至还有特殊电脉冲，强行勾起我的性欲！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: I ended up having to catch my breath for a while before I could follow through

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: with official procedure and clean up the VR training arena.

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Prior to my first round of using it, I used to wonder why a third of the manual
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 第一次使用前，我还纳闷为什么说明书有三分之一

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 都在讲VR装备的保养和清洁消毒……

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: ...but I've probably bored you enough, haven't I puppo?
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……不过小狗狗，我大概已经把你讲烦了吧？

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我说的这些，你大概连一半都没听懂吧？

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: But you sat through my whole story like a good boy!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可你还是乖乖听完了我的故事，真是个乖孩子！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Awww you're too cute for me to collect data from. And maybe too small, too!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哎呀，你太可爱，我都舍不得采数据了。或许也太小了！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Why don't you run along and we'll call this an IOU, huh?
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你先去玩吧，这次就算欠着，怎么样？

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Maybe you'll give the Kobolds a run for their money when you're older
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 等你长大些，说不定就能跟科博德一较高下了，

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: and then you can hit me up for something a bit more adult oriented.
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: and then you can hit me up for something a bit more adult oriented.

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: W-woah, wait a second there pupper! This isn't the place to dig for buried bones!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哇、等等，狗狗！这儿可不是挖骨头的地方！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Who knows what sort of stuff could be stuck in the ground here?
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 谁知道这儿地底下埋着什么？

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: It could be dangerous wires, or a secret weapon stash, or even something like...
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没准是危险电线、秘密军火库，甚至是……

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: ...like a keycard for this area! Wow! Are you really giving this to me?!?
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……比如这片区域的门卡！哇！真要送给我？！？

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: Gee you're an even awesomer pup than I thought! This is great!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哇，你这狗狗比我想的还棒！太好了！

vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.source: text: With this I should be able to make my way even deeper into this area!
vsn/m_ClassicWerepup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 有了这个，我应该就能深入这片区域了！

vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.source: text: What? Trying to spirit away again?
text: Come on! There's no way you're getting away like that!
vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 少来！你休想就这么逃走！

vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.source: text: Hang on lil bro, I'm about to show you some real flying!
vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 抓紧了，弟弟，马上让你见识什么才叫真正的驾驶技术！

vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.source: text: Watch me put this baby into overdrive, and then I'll-
vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 看我让这宝贝全速运转，然后我就——

vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.source: text: There's no way to catch up to her now, she's out of sight completely!
vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 现在根本追不上她了，已经完全看不见她了！

vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.source: text: Darn it all!! If only this ship was fully repaired with all its parts!
vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 真是可恶！！要是这艘飞船的零件都配齐、彻底修好了就好了！

vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.source: text: ...I guess there's nothing else we can do, baby bro.
vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……我想我们也没别的办法了，小弟。

vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.source: text: Just have to hope that Traeh doesn't manage to get her energy back...
vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 只能希望特蕾没法恢复她的能量了……

vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.source: text: ...and hope that the galaxy is safe...
vsn/m_EndingBad/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……也希望银河系平安无事……

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: Nooo! Curse you damn Yiffai siblings!
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不要啊！诅咒你们，该死的伊法伊姐弟！

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: I was supposed to rule the world... no... the Galaxy!
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我本该统治世界的……不……是整个银河！
text: 嘎啊啊啊——呜噢噢噢——呃呃呃！

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: Wow sis, did we really just... save a whole planet?
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哇，姐姐，我们刚才真的……救了整整一颗星球？

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: Yeah lil bro, I think we did! Par for the course on my missions, really.
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 是啊，小弟，我想是的！在我执行的任务里这都算家常便饭了。

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: Buuut pretty impressive for my baby bro's first real mission, so good going!
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不——过嘛，对我家小弟的第一次真正任务来说已经相当厉害了，干得漂亮！

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: The heroes of Tutone! They return!
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 图托恩的英雄们！他们回来了！

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: Traeh has been defeated, her psychic disturbances are no more and her minions flee!
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 特蕾已被击败，她的灵能扰动不复存在，她的手下四散逃窜！

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: BLESSED BE THE COSMOBREEDERS, SAVIORS OF OUR PLANET!
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 愿宇宙育种者受颂，我们星球的救星！

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: Wow, good going you two! Clearing out a whole planet of baddies...
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 哇，你们俩真棒！把整颗星球的坏蛋都清理干净了……

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: That's definitely gonna help the local fauna get back on track!
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这肯定能帮当地的动物们重回正轨！

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: I knew you two could do it. Never had a doubt in my mind.
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我就知道你们俩能做到。我心里从没怀疑过。

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: Not even when one of you went AWOL and stopped responding to all communica-
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 就连你们中有人擅离职守、不再回应任何通——

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: This will definitely be a good report to have filed away, Agents!
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这份报告绝对值得归档留存，特工们！

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: Nice one, grrrrl! You and your pup brother really cleaned up down there!
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 干得漂亮，grrrrl！你和你的小狗弟弟在下面真把坏蛋都清理光了！

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: Just don't forget about us at HQ when all the fame goes to your heads, alright?
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 只是等名气让你们忘乎所以的时候，可别忘了还在总部的我们，好吗？

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: HOORAH FOR YIFFANY AND YIFFAI! STAR COSMOBREEDERS!
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 为伊法妮和伊法伊欢呼！明星级宇宙育种者！

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: H O O R A Y ! ! !
text: Heh, how about that, sis? We made a pretty good team, didn't we?
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 嘿，瞧见没，姐姐？我们配合得挺不错，不是吗？

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: Wellll... you did alright, bro.
text: [SO ENDS THE REPORT ON PLANET TUTONE.]
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [图托恩星球的报告至此结束。]

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: [A PLANET WITH A TUMULTUOUS HISTORY, FACING THE GREATEST CHALLENGES OF ITS TIME]
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [一颗历史动荡、正面临其时代最严峻挑战的星球]

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: [SAVED BY THE VALIANT EFFORTS OF TWO BRAVE COSMOBREEDERS:]
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [因两位勇敢的宇宙育种者的英勇努力而获救：]

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: [YIFFANY YIFFAI, ELDER SISTER AND SEASONED VETERAN WITH UNMATCHED COMBAT SKILL]
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [伊法妮·伊法伊，姐姐，久经沙场的老兵，拥有无与伦比的战斗技巧]

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: [AND YIFFAI YIFFAI, THE YOUNGER BROTHER PRODIGY WITH UNENDING ENTHUSIASM]
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [以及伊法伊·伊法伊，热情永不枯竭的天才弟弟]

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: [WITH THE TWO OF THEM TEAMED UP, THERE'S NO MISSION THAT THEY CAN'T HANDLE]
vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [两人联手，没有他们应付不了的任务]

vsn/m_EndingGood/script.vsn.source: text: [AND THE PPP IS PROUD TO HAVE THEM AS AGENTS.]                      -SIGNED, BOSSU
