vsn/m_EndingIntoShmup/script.vsn.source: text: What? Trying to spirit away again?
text: Come on! There's no way you're getting away like that!
vsn/m_EndingIntoShmup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 少来！你休想就这么逃走！

vsn/m_EndingIntoShmup/script.vsn.source: text: Hang on lil bro, I'm about to show you some real flying!
vsn/m_EndingIntoShmup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 抓紧了，弟弟，马上让你见识什么才叫真正的驾驶技术！

vsn/m_EndingIntoShmup/script.vsn.source: text: Here we go! Full turbo! This ship is fully locked and fully loaded!
vsn/m_EndingIntoShmup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 来了！涡轮全开！这艘飞船武器就绪，弹药满载！

vsn/m_EndingIntoShmup/script.vsn.source: text: Now let's take down this wannabe queen for real!
vsn/m_EndingIntoShmup/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 现在就来彻底打倒这个妄称女王的家伙！

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: Ow, I didn't expect to take such a rough bump.
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 嗷，没想到会挨这么重的一下。

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: Guess I can use this chance to practice writing an end-of-capture report!
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 正好借机练习写被俘结束报告！

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: Lessee, just gotta start paying attention and see if anything notable happens
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 让我想想，得开始留神，看看有没有值得记录的事，

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: between now and the end of this short...
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 从现在到这段小小的……结束之前。

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: Would you look at that? Must've slept for quite a while since I was all groggy
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 瞧瞧这事！我肯定睡了挺久，醒来还迷迷糊糊的

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: and woke to find myself being locked into some restraints!
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 一醒来，就发现自己正被套上拘束具！

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: Not only that, but the jerks that were locking me into these cuffs...
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不光如此，那些把我锁进镣铐的混蛋……

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: ...looked just like that shorty that stole my gear to begin with!!
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……居然跟一开始偷我装备的矮子长得一模一样！！

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: As soon as they got me chained up in some sort of ramshackle den of theirs
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们刚把我锁进那破破烂烂的窝里

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: they started to take turns rutting me. Didn't even get me dinner first or anything!
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们就开始轮流操我。都不先请我吃顿饭！

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: With the shorties being so small it wasn't much of a workout for a pro like me
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这些小矮子个头太小，对我这种老手根本算不上运动

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: but I could tell that these squeakers were pretty desperate for some release.
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不过我看得出，这些吱吱怪都急着发泄呢。

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: It was actually kinda fun to see the little fellas go to town on my tail...heh!
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 看这些小家伙对着我尾巴底下猛干，还挺有意思……嘿！

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: One after another they took turns, must've been at least a dozen of them...
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们一个接一个轮着来，少说也有十几个……

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: The little guys only bred me one at a time but you could tell they were pent up
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 小家伙们一次只来一个，可看得出都憋坏了

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: by all the squeaking and chittering they were doing.
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 光听他们吱吱喳喳，就知道憋得多难受。

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: Every now and again one would get squeaked at for delaying the line
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 时不时就有一个因耽误排队，被吱吱叫着催促

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: and they'd get hurried along while still squirting!
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们还在射，就被催着赶走了！

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: Being the center of so much attention was actually kinda fun.
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 被这么多家伙团团围着，其实还挺好玩。

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: Learned a lot about their breeding habits
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我学到了不少他们的交配习性

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: but I was almost dis- appointed that there were no larger specimens to study!
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可惜没更大的个体供研究，我还真有点失望！

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: Almost, until I noticed that I was alone in the cell.
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 差点就是了，直到我发现牢房只剩我一个。

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: The little guys had left while I was getting lost in my thoughts, rude, right?
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那帮小个子趁我走神时溜了，很没礼貌吧？

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: I was just about to break out of there when my ears picked up the soft sounds of
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我正准备逃出去，耳朵却捕捉到轻微的声响

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: someone creeping along the stones.
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 有人正沿着石地悄悄靠近。

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: Suddenly, out of the shadows came a giant beast of a creature!
vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 突然，一头巨兽从阴影里走了出来！

vsn/m_GameOverArea0/script.vsn.source: text: A muscled feline that could have probably torn me in half!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: After collaring me up all nice and spiffy, I was led out to some sort of stage
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 给我戴上那漂亮又神气的项圈后，他们把我带上了一个台子

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: with plenty of pirates and aliens of all sort watching!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 台下围着一大群海盗和各色外星人！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: They seemed to be waiting for some kind of show to start...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们好像在等某场表演开场……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: ...but what was the show? This could be some important data to collect!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……可是什么表演呢？这说不定是值得收集的重要数据！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: Well, a cold nose under my tail helped clue me in to what the show was gonna be.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 尾巴下面一碰到冰鼻头，我就猜到要演什么了。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: An orange furred Barker had been let loose on me before I was even able to stand
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我还没来得及站起来，一只橙毛吠犬就被放过来扑向我，

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: It was so long since I was together with anything that wasn't a Kobold that I...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我太久没跟科博德以外的家伙做过了，以至于……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: ...I just sort of froze while the Barker moved to mount me!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……那只吠犬爬上来要骑我时，我就这么僵住了！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: The shock of all this hap- pening while I was under a blindingly bright spotlight
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这一切竟发生在刺眼的聚光灯下，吓得我

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: snapped me out of my Kobold pleasure fascination real quick!!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 一下就把我从科博德的快感迷恋里惊醒了！！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: After taking note of the Barker's giant canid phallus and the copius ejaculations
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 记录完吠犬的巨大犬型鸡巴和惊人射精量后

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: I looked around to see what I was /really/ taking part of.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我环顾四周，想看看自己/究竟/在参与什么。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: ...and it was an auction! They were auctioning off... me?!?
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……居然是拍卖会！他们在拍卖……我？！？

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: That was all I had time to process before the Barker shoved that huge knot inside
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我才刚反应过来，吠犬就把那巨大的结塞了进来，

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: causing me to freeze up ag- ain while I tried to process just how... huge! It! Was!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我又僵住了，努力理解它到底……有！多！大！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: I could barely keep my mind straight as the Barker dragged me along the stage
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 吠犬拖着我在台上走时，我脑子都快转不动了

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: showing off my raised tail to all the alien auction goers.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 向所有外星竞拍客展示我翘起的尾巴。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: Pretty sure I heard the sounds of bidding before I blacked out once more...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 再次昏过去前，我分明听见了竞价声……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: So, yeah. Kobolds love me! Or at least, they /loved/ me.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以嘛，科博德都爱我！至少，他们/爱过/我。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: I can tell you all sorts of sexy tidbits about them, just try me!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们那些色色的小知识，我知道一大堆，尽管问！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.source: text: ...what planet are we on, anyways?
vsn/m_GameOverAreaB/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……话说，我们这是在哪颗星球？

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Ouch! That last blow really ruffled my fluff!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 嗷！刚才那一下真把我的毛都打乱了！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: But everyone's counting on me, so I gotta get back up and keep fighting!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可大家都指望着我呢，我得爬起来接着战斗！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Nnhg... just... need a moment... to lay here and catch my breath...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 嗯呃……只要……在这躺一小会儿……喘口气……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): Black
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): Black

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...but... so... so dizzy...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……可……好……好晕……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...huh?
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……嗯？

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Who are you...?
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你是谁……？

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: fadein(1.0, 4): ClassicGameOverAreaCB
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: fadein(1.0, 4): ClassicGameOverAreaCB

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Hopefully the data recorders got all this. I seem to have been 'acquired' by
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 希望记录器都录下来了。我似乎被人“收归己有”了——

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: one of the two bipedal species native to this area, the Gobins.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这片区域两种原生双足物种之一——哥布林。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: As the big male carried me into the woods, I was still too dazed to put up a fight.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那大块头雄性把我抱进树林时，我还晕得无力反抗。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: I tried to tell him that I was on a really important mission, but either
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我想告诉他，我在执行重大任务，可他要么

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: he didn't speak galactic... or he just didn't care...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他听不懂银河通用语……要么就是根本不在乎……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCC
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCC

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Once he got me back to the Gobin village, I was in for a really rude welcome!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他把我带回哥布林村后，那欢迎仪式可真粗暴！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: They immediately took turns passing me around and breeding me on the spot!!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们当场就把我传来传去，轮流操了起来！！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: They were so big, and they just used me like I was a toy.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们那么大，把我当玩具一样随意玩弄。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Just jamming their hot Gobin cocks all the way up into my tummy, again and again!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 一遍又一遍，把滚烫的哥布林鸡巴直捅到我肚子里！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: It was... Ugh... Rough... tiring... But kinda nice, at first...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那感觉……呃……粗暴……累人……可起初还挺舒服……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: The others pawwed through my equipment, jabbering about it and sorting it.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 其他家伙用爪子翻拣我的装备，叽里呱啦地分着类。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: I didn't see any of that gear again. I think they sold it to space pirates...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那些装备我再也没见过，估计被卖给太空海盗了……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCD
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCD

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Once they had their fill, they put me in a hanging cage at edge of the village.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 他们尽兴后，把我关进村边悬吊的笼子里。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: After that? I'm not sure how long they kept me... A week? Two...?
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 再后来？我也不知被关了多久……一周？两周……？

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: I don't think I ever got more than an hour of rest between rough breedings.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 两次粗暴交配之间，我大概从没休息超过一小时。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: The morning patrols... the afternoon patrols... I was free use for everyone!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 早班巡逻……午班巡逻……谁都能随便用我！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: At least we'll have *plenty* of data on the male Gobin's breeding habits now,
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 至少现在，雄性哥布林的配种习性数据可*管够*了，

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: collected by me... ah...! painstakingly...! inch by... ugh... *thick* inch!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 全是我……啊……辛苦收集的！一寸……呃……*粗大*的一寸！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCE
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCE

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Look, I'm a bottom agent right? I knew what I was signing up for...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 听着，我是个下位特工，好吧？我知道自己报名来干嘛……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...but jeez, even I've got my limits! This was all too much!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……可天哪，我也有极限！这实在太过了！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: I wanted to escape, but all those Gobin cocks really took the fight out of me...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我想逃，可那些哥布林的鸡巴把我操得没力气反抗了……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...and they kept a real close eye on me in my cage, too.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……他们还把笼里的我看得死死的。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Even the slightest untoward movement was an invitation for another rough pounding!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 稍有不安分，就会招来又一顿粗暴猛干！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): Black
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): Black

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: So... as much as I'd like to say that I executed a brilliant escape plan...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 所以……我很想说，是我施展了绝妙逃脱计划……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...it was really just dumb luck, the way it happened.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……其实事情就那么发生了，全靠瞎猫碰上死耗子。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: The Gobins watching me were urgently called away one night.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 有天夜里，看守我的哥布林被紧急叫走了。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: I think maybe one of their raids wasn't going well, but I'm not sure...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 也许是他们哪次劫掠不太顺利，我也不确定……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCG
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCG

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Somehow, I scrambled down the nearest tree. My legs were shaking.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 不知怎么的，我从最近的树上爬了下来，双腿直打颤。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: I had no gear, no comms, stranded in the middle of an alien forest...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没装备、没通讯，我被困在外星森林深处……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: My only hope was to somehow make my way back to the hangar and regroup.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 唯一的希望，就是设法回机库重整旗鼓。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCH
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCH

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...but I didn't make it far before I was intercepted. Not by Gobins, thankfully.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……可没跑多远就被拦住了。幸好不是哥布林。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: It was a tall Elf lady. Someone who could speak my language, at least.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那是个高挑的精灵女子。至少终于有人会说我的语言了。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: But when I tried to explain about my super important rescue mission...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 可我试着解释自己那超级重要的救援任务时……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...she just kept... cooing at me...?
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……她却一直……柔声哄我……？

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCI
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCI

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: I didn't have the strength to resist her as she led me away to the other elves
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 她领我去找其他精灵时，我已没力气反抗，

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: and soon I found myself fussed over and bathed in a quiet forest spring.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 很快，我就在幽静的林间泉水里，被他们围着伺候洗澡。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: The elves ignored my weak protests, responding only with sweet nothings...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 精灵们无视我软弱的抗议，只说着甜言蜜语……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: 'There there little one, just relax...' and so on.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: “乖，乖，小家伙，放松就好……”之类的。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCJ
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCJ

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: After my rough and messy Gobin captivity, this was all so relaxing...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 被哥布林粗暴地折腾了那么久，这一切太放松了……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...I guess I just kinda... melted... and let the elves do... hmmf...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……我好像就这么……酥软了……任由精灵们……嗯唔……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: ...whatever they wanted with me.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……随他们怎么摆弄我。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: My head swam. I felt... intoxicated...?
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我头晕目眩，感觉……像醉了……？

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Was it something in the water here...? Or an Elfin PSY power...?
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 是这里的水有问题……？还是精灵的精神力……？

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCK
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCK

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Everything's a bit of a blur after that.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 后来的事都记得有些模糊了。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: I just did as I was told, and it kept feeling better and better...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我只是乖乖照做，却越来越舒服……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: 'Come here puppy, into my lap... good puppy,' they cooed...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 她们柔声哄道：‘过来，小狗，来我腿上……乖狗狗。’

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: The few times my mission poked through the mind haze, I couldn't focus for long...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 偶尔从迷糊中记起任务，也集中不了多久……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: 'Shush, little one. Open your legs... lift your tail...'
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ‘嘘，小家伙。张开腿……抬起尾巴……’

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCL
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): ClassicGameOverAreaCL

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Now that I've collected my thoughts, everything has become totally clear.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 如今整理好思绪，一切都彻底明白了。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: It was foolish for me, a dumb little puppy, to think I could save the planet...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我这只傻小狗竟想拯救星球，真是愚蠢……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: My place is to follow along quietly and to serve my mistresses.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 我就该安静跟随，侍奉我的女主人们。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: cut(0.06): Black
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: cut(0.06): Black

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: rewind!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: rewind!

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: If you're watching this, know that the galaxy is in safe hands now.
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 看到这段录像的人请放心，银河如今有人守护了。

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Trust in the proud Elf rangers of Sceafya and their wise leader...
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 相信斯凯菲亚骄傲的精灵游侠，以及他们睿智的领袖吧……

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: text: Her peerless grace, my queen! High Lady Enelye!
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 风华绝代的陛下，我的女王！恩内莉大人！

vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.source: wait: 0.2
vsn/m_GameOverAreaC/script.vsn.r27_localized: wait: 0.2

vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [Agent Yiffai did not return from his mission on Planet Tutone.]
vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [特工伊法伊前往图托恩星执行任务后，未能归来。]

vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [He was last active on EXILE, a small asteroid orbiting the planet.]
vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [他最后在流放地活动，那是一颗绕行星运行的小行星。]

vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [Based on his final recordings, it is unlikely that the agent survived...]
vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [根据最后的影像记录，该特工恐已遇难……]

vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [...but, as no remains have been recovered, his precise fate remains unclear.]
vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [……但由于尚未寻获遗骸，他的确切下落仍不明。]

vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [All agent communications from Tutone have since ceased.]
vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [此后，图托恩所有特工的通讯都中断了。]

vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [Our mission logs indicate that some dark 'queen' might be in search of]
vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [任务日志显示，某位黑暗“女王”可能正在寻找]

vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.source: text: [a new host body, and may be seeking to expand her influence beyond Tutone...]
vsn/m_GameOverAreaE/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [一具新宿主，或许还想把势力扩张到图托恩之外……]

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: [STARDATE XXXX:XXXX:XXXX.XX] [PLANET TUTONE, 5555 SYSTEM] [MAGNETOSHEATHE ENTRY POINT]
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: [星历 XXXX:XXXX:XXXX.XX] [5555星系，图托恩星] [磁鞘进入点]

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: ...entry successful, en route to descend at 40N, 74W in T-minus XXXX unisecs.
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……成功进入，正飞往北纬40、西经74，倒计时XXXX标准秒后降落。

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Engine temp stable at 2640 degrees, plasma, oxygen and battery levels good.
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 引擎温度稳定在2640度，等离子、氧气和电量正常。

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: This is Cosmobreeder Yiffai, requesting mission update from CO Bossu, over!
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 这里是宇宙育种者伊法伊，请求Bossu指挥官更新任务情报，完毕！

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Now listen up here agent Yiffai, you may have graduated top of your class
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 听好了，伊法伊特工，你虽然以全班第一毕业，

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: but we wouldn't have sent you on this mission if we had any other choice.
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 但凡还有别的选择，我们都不会派你执行这次任务。

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Oh come on, still worried because this is my virgin flight? I'll be on my guard!
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 拜托，还因为这是我头回出航就担心？我会小心的！

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Especially if my sister was among the agents that disappeared mid-mission.
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 尤其姐姐可能就在那些任务中失踪的特工里。

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: That's right, we can't be too careful. You're the only capable agent we had left.
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 没错，再谨慎也不为过。你是我们仅剩的能干特工了。

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Just remember, your mission here is to gather useful bio data
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 记住，你在这里的任务是收集有用的生物数据

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: while also attempting to find your missing fellow agents, wherever they are.
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 同时设法找回失踪的特工同伴，无论他们身在何处。
text: 只要确……保……你……多加……小……心……

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Mewahaha! What's this? Another little spacebug entering my domain?
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 喵哈哈！这是什么？又一只太空小虫闯进我的地盘？

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Enjoy your crash landing like your other little interlopers did, puppy!
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 小狗，跟其他小入侵者一样，好好享受坠机吧！

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Who the heck are you calling a pup?!?
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你到底叫谁小狗呢？！？

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: And how the heck did these ships sneak up on me?
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 还有，这些船到底怎么偷偷摸到我身边的？

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Gah! There's too many of them! I need to make an emergency landing!
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 啊！敌人太多了！我得紧急迫降！

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Commander! If you can hear me, I can't wait for permission, sorry!
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 指挥官！如果你听得见，抱歉，我等不及批准了！

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Geeeeeze, those buggy buggers did a number on my paint job!
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 天啊啊，那帮臭虫把我的涂装毁惨了！

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Don't they know that repairs and touch ups come out of my paycheck? The bastards...
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 修理补漆可是要扣我工资的，他们不知道吗？混蛋……

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Post orbital thrusters are hecked up, but this jalopy of mine should still fly.
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 后轨道推进器坏了，不过我这老破船应该还能飞。

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Just need to get into this sneaking suit now that I'm terra bound, and...
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 既然落地了，先穿上这身潜行服，然后……
text: 这都什么跟什么啊！！

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Who the heck are you!?! And what are you doing with my gear!?!
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 你到底是谁？！？拿我的装备干什么？！？

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: That little jerk just took my stuff and jumped down this hole!
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 那小混蛋抢了我的东西，就跳进这洞里了！

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: ...now that I think about it, though...
text: ...I don't really remember where I was supposed to start my search...
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: ……我不太记得该从哪里开始搜寻了……

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: Alright! No time to worry about it! Just gotta go for it!
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 好！没空发愁了！直接上就是！

vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.source: text: The valuable biodata and the safety of my fellow agents is depending on me!
vsn/m_GameStart/script.vsn.r27_localized: text: 珍贵的生物数据，还有同僚的安危，全靠我了！
